text: Legislate a Democratic Exit Clause for All Nations of the United Kingdom Legislate to create a democratic, peaceful withdrawal process for any UK nation from the Union. We believe that without a more clearly codified exit route, the Union could risk becoming involuntary. We think this could undermine democracy and breach the UK’s international obligations.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Require all public buildings to display the Union Jack flag We believe in celebrating and honouring the rich history and heritage of the United Kingdom. We think displaying the Union Jack on public buildings will serve as a daily reminder of our collective history, fostering a sense of pride and belonging among citizens of all backgrounds.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Tax all welfare and benefits at identical rates as earned income Ensure all welfare and benefits payments, allowances and subsidies are subject to identical personal tax, national insurance rates and starting thresholds as earned and pension income
label: HM Treasury

text: Revoke the BBC's royal charter & right to charge a licence fee Revoke the BBC's Charter and right to charge a licence fee.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Introduce stricter controls and awareness campaigns to stop nitrous oxide misuse We want tighter rules on nitrous oxide sales, stronger enforcement against illegal supply, and national awareness campaigns showing its dangers. We want the Government to act to protect young people and prevent more lives being lost to this potentially dangerous substance.
label: Home Office

text: Fund more clinics for thyroid advice & support  To support individuals who get diagnosed with this autoimmune disease.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ensure the NIHR dedicates at least 3% of annual funding to menopause research Menopause affects all women/people born with ovaries who live long enough. It has a considerable effect on long term health, the economy & quality of life, yet in April 2022-April 23 just 0.3% of NIHR's £1.25bn budget was spent on menopause research (6/852 studies). We believe this needs to change.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Require all MPs to be solely British Citizens I think that MPs only loyalty should be with the United Kingdom. I think that if MPs have dual nationality or are citizens of the Republic of Ireland or a commonwealth country, there could be a conflict of interest between loyalty to the United Kingdom and loyalty to another country.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Stop using the fair maintainable trade calculation for pubs’ business rates  Change the unique way by which public houses are assessed for business rates. We think this will help to slow down the closures of public houses. Current taxation policies are making ever-increasing numbers of public houses unviable.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Stop all armaments exports to Israel We think there should be a complete blockade of UK exports of armaments or part of armaments to Israel.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Compensate Civil Servants for delays in their pensions The Government should compensate all those Civil Servants and others that have been financially impacted by failure to pay pension benefits on time, and failure to communicate in an appropriate manner.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Ban businesses adding service charges to bills without prior customer consent I want the Government to ban restaurants and hotels from automatically adding service charges to bills without prior customer consent. I feel many businesses take advantage of diners by imposing these charges without making it clear that they are optional.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Call a public inquiry on Israeli & Russia influence on UK politics & democracy We call on the UK Government to launch a public inquiry which looks into introducing stronger safeguards to protect the UK from reported efforts from Israel and Russia to influence the UK’s democracy.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Require large hotel chains to provide properly equipped accessible rooms We want the Government to change the law so large hotel chains must offer a minimum number of properly equipped accessible rooms for 1 or 2 guests at fair prices.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Urgent Review and Reform of the CICA Scheme While the mission behind the Criminal Injuries Compensation Authority (CICA) to compensate innocent victims of crime is vital, we feel its current operational methods are failing the very people it was designed to protect.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Remove VAT on all school uniform up to age 18 We would like VAT charges to be removed on all school uniform items as part of a general move by our government to make uniforms more affordable for families.
label: HM Treasury

text: Improve NHS diagnosis, treatment, and awareness of TMJ (jaw joint) disorders. We want the Government to improve TMJ care by creating a verified specialist directory, funding NHS education and early imaging, supporting tailored treatment planning, and backing a UK TMJ charity to provide information, advocacy, and raise public awareness.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban suspensions of primary school aged children with additional needs We want the government to ban suspensions of primary school aged children with additional needs. We think suspensions can significantly impact a child’s progression and change needs to happen.
label: Department for Education

text: Provide funding to develop a national programme for SEN children during holiday I urge the government to provide funding to develop a consistent, national programme of holiday provision for SEN children. This should include, a range of inclusive holiday clubs and activities, trained staff equipped to support SEN children and those with more complex or challenging behaviours.
label: Department for Education

text: Require schools to ban students use of smartphones during school hours We want the Government to introduce a policy that requires schools to ban smartphones during school hours, including break time. We think this could help ensure a focused and productive learning environment.
label: Department for Education

text: Make mental health screening mandatory after military deployments Require all Armed Forces personnel to have a mental health screening with a qualified clinician before post-deployment leave. This could help identify hidden struggles, provide early support, and reduce suicide risk among service members.
label: Ministry of Defence

text: Fund £8,580 per home-educated child per year  Fund each home-educated child £8,580 a year. If the state mandates registers and oversight via the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill, we believe funding must follow the child. We save the taxpayer over a billion pounds each year; we deserve a fair share for exam fees and resources.
label: Department for Education

text: Replace First-Past-The-Post with Single Transferrable Vote & Alternative Vote We urge the Government to abolish First-Past-The-Post (FPTP) for all elections. We would like the Government to replace it with Single Transferrable Vote for General and Council elections, and Alternative Vote for mayoral and by-elections.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Fund a national diagnostic DLD pathway & better services for people with DLD Fund a national diagnostic Developmental Language Disorder (DLD) pathway and improved services for those with DLD. This pathway should raise awareness, understanding and inclusion of DLD, provide early intervention and DLD training for professionals in the public & education sectors.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Reduce Child ILR from 7 to 5 Years; End Part Suitability Rule. We demand the Government reduce the 7-year ILR wait to 5 years for UK-born children, and permanently exclude the Part Suitability policy from their applications.
label: Home Office

text: Introduce mandatory sewing & textile lessons into the National Curriculum & EYFS I ask the Government to consider introducing specific, mandatory lessons on sewing & textile skills into the National Curriculum, and Early Years Foundation Stage for nursery children. Currently, nurseries may teach sewing via continuous provision but it may not continue for all children in Year 1.
label: Department for Education

text: Require all PIP assessments & reviews be conducted by doctors Currently people we think are under-qualified are carrying out PIP assessments & reviews. We feel this is unfair as PIP claimants should be assessed by practising doctors and in complex cases, specialist doctors, not occupational therapists, nurses, physiotherapists, paramedics, or pharmacists.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Bring back full Right to buy discount & give notice of future changes Revert back to the full discount on Right to buy properties. Give notice of future changes to all tenants, should the Government wish to reduce the discount in future. Do not make changes that will affect people’s rights without notification.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Remove all duplicate telecommunications infrastructure & enforce sharing deals We want this Government to enforce sharing arrangements of pre-existing infrastructure & ENSURE THAT ALL DUPLICATE INFRASTRUCTURE IS REMOVED.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Review and fund alternative tests for Lyme disease We are concerned that the two-tier Lyme test can give some false negatives, including early on or in immunosuppressed people. We urge a review of broader, potentially more accurate tests to detect all strains. We think this will help prepare for future Lyme vaccines and ensure more timely treatment.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Fund research and staff training on Mast Cell Activation Syndrome Fund research into Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS) and related mast cell conditions, and fund training for NHS healthcare professionals. We think this would improve recognition, diagnosis, and treatment, and give patients access to safe NHS care instead of potentially costly private options.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Provide free education transport for children aged 16-19 with EHCPs I would like the government to change the rules for the statutory provision of transport for children with education, health and care plans (EHCPs). I want them to protect in law the right to education transport for all children with an EHCP between the ages of 16 and 19
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Amend the Highway Code to incorporate Horse Riders'/handlers' hand signals Add a photographic page of horse riders' hand signals used while on the road to clarify urgently for safety reasons what is referred to in 2 sections of the Highway Code, namely section 215 & the one on Signals to other Road users, so that they align with what is taught to horse riders.
label: Department for Transport

text: Change law: OFWAT to block dividends & executive bonuses when rationing water Change the Water (Special Measures) Act to require OFWAT to block executive bonuses and payment of shareholder dividends in the event of water companies declaring water rationing measures.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Hold an immediate parliamentary vote on US use of UK bases We call on the Government to hold a parliamentary vote on the decision to grant the United States permission to use British military bases for strikes on Iranian missile sites.
label: Ministry of Defence

text: We call on Government to support the Climate and Nature Bill We believe the Climate and Nature (CAN) Bill is the only science-led legislation comprehensive enough to tackle the current climate and environmental emergencies at the scale needed. We want Government to fully support this Bill and give Parliament time and opportunity to pass it.
label: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

text: Introduce more regulations around the sale and use of crossbows I am asking the government to introduce and enforce much stronger laws for the sale and use of crossbows. I think they're a threat to both people and animals.
label: Home Office

text: Introduce compulsory voting, 50% winning threshold and non-of-the-above option I want the government to change the system at all general elections from now on.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Detain all illegal immigrants and put in camping sites on airfields All Illegal immigrants from small boat crossings should be placed in secure camping sites on disused airfields until their asylum case is heard. We think this might appease the British public and keep all parties safe.
label: Home Office

text:
Work with others to give frozen Russian assets to Ukraine There are approximately $300 billion worth of frozen Russian assets in G7 and EU countries.
We think the UK Government should work with these other countries to develop a plan to give these assets to Ukraine.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Scrap the Immigration Health Surcharge for those living & working in the UK We believe the Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is causing severe financial harm to migrants and their families. At present, the standard IHS fee is £1,035 per year. For a 10-year visa, this amounts to £10,350. We believe migrants working and paying taxes should be exempt from paying the IHS.
label: Home Office

text: Change business rates relief for 25/26 back to 75%. We believe the Government’s decision to cut the retail, hospitality and leisure business rates reliefs from 75% to 40% from 1 April could mean thousands of businesses will see business rates bills rise significantly in the year ahead. We believe such rises may be unsustainable for many.
label: HM Treasury

text: Abolish inheritance tax We see Inheritance tax as a tax on the already taxed, and we think it needs to be removed.
label: HM Treasury

text: Ban fireworks We believe fireworks should be banned, as we think they are cruel to animals.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: We want Parliament to endorse the ICJ ruling on UNRWA. The ICJ highlighted the urgent humanitarian needs in Gaza and the unique capacity of UNRWA to address these needs effectively.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Funding for finger-prick glucose test for all unwell children of any age in A&E Fund all NHS A&E departments to do finger-prick blood glucose tests on all unwell babies, toddlers, and children, even if symptoms seem minor, specific, or common, to detect undiagnosed Type 1 diabetes and early DKA, preventing life-threatening complications.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Raise the minimum sentence for hit-and-run crimes to two years imprisonment Currently, the maximum penalty for leaving the scene of an accident is only six months’ imprisonment. Offenders are often given a fine, points, or community service. We feel this is not strong enough punishment and should be increased.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Commission an independent inquiry into social care and social work We call on the Government to commission an independent inquiry into the delivery of social work and social care services before making further progress on the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Bill.
label: Department for Education

text: Stop new powers limiting repeat protests Withdraw proposals to give police powers to restrict or ban “repeat protests". We think these measures undermine the right to free expression, peaceful assembly and democratic participation in the UK. Peaceful protest is a vital part of holding Government to account. Defend free speech.
label: Home Office

text: Amend Children Act 1989 to presume grandchild-grandparent contact Based on sound UK evidence, we ask to amend the Children Act 1989 to presume (unless there are safeguarding factors) that involvement of a grandparent in a grandchild's life will further their welfare.
label: Department for Education

text: Require 3-month SEN school placements for all trainee teachers I want the Government to require all trainee teachers to complete a 3-month placement in Special Educational Needs schools so they can understand neurodiverse children, learn strategies to support them, and ensure every child can thrive in mainstream education.
label: Department for Education

text: Legislate to create a threshold limit on parking charge increases by UK Councils We urge the Government to legislate to create an annual threshold limit on parking charge increases made by councils each year to prevent large hikes. We feel current percentage increases of on-street parking charges could disproportionately affect vulnerable groups, neurodivergent and pensioners.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Criminalise failing to report hitting cats with a vehicle & taking them to a vet Make it a criminal offence to hit a cat with a vehicle and drive away and legally require reporting collisions and taking them to the vet immediately. Social media posts show the cruelty of leaving cats to suffer horrific injuries or die alone in pain.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Set legal limits for PFAS in drinking water, ban PFAS in consumer goods and food Introduce binding legal limits for PFAS in UK drinking water. Ban PFAS in cookware, cosmetics, fabrics, carpets and food packaging and pesticides with no extended phase-in period. Make polluters pay for clean-up and force companies to switch to safe alternatives, with penalties for non-compliance.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Ban councils from selling allotments We want the government to rescind permission given for local councils to sell council owned allotments. Prevent any further sales and permissions being granted.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text:
Fund/legislate for improved security and facilities for HGV drivers We want the Government to:
1 Invest in secure HGV parking facilities with fencing, lighting, CCTV, & security patrols
2 Increase funding for roadside security measures at existing rest stops & laybys.
3 Introduce specific freight crime legislation to ensure tougher penalties for organised theft
label: Department for Transport

text: Increase funding for EHCPs to help address funding gaps in schools We want EHCP funding to be increased for schools. For some, funding doesn’t cover the support required in the EHCP. We think that funding shouldn’t be based on banding but actual costs. EHCPs must fully fund staff, therapies, equipment, and training to meet a child’s needs effectively and lawfully.
label: Department for Education

text: Review the NPPF to strengthen protections for Green Belt and National Landscapes Review and amend the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF) to introduce clear national standards for protecting Green Belt, Grey Belt and National Landscapes. Require brownfield land, urban densification, infrastructure and Green Infrastructure to be assessed before protected land is allocated.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Introduce Albanian GCSE and A-levels  We ask the Government to introduce GCSE and A-Level qualifications in the Albanian language. Thousands of children attend Albanian supplementary schools and would benefit from a nationally recognised qualification in their mother tongue.
label: Department for Education

text: All nannies, tutors and babysitters to have an enhanced DBS check. We urge the Government to allow and require anyone working as a nanny, tutor, or babysitter to have a valid enhanced DBS check before beginning their role. We think by doing this we can create a safer environment for children.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Fund the creation of more SEN schools We feel that there are not enough SEN schools to accommodate SEN children. We think there are SEN children struggling through mainstream school and having to be home educated because they simply cannot cope with mainstream school.
label: Department for Education

text: Give More Power to Public Petitions to Force the Government to take Action We call for petitions on petition.parliament.uk to enable action beyond a debate. We feel recent petitions with huge public support have been dismissed by government, and that this undermines faith in the process. More milestones are needed which force governmental action.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Increase highway funding & ringfence fuel duty & road tax for road maintenance We want the Government to increase capital highway funding for local authorities and ringfence a fixed percentage of revenue from the Fuel Duty Tax and Road Tax to meet the “steady state” maintenance requirement and allow for a permanent structural repair.
label: Department for Transport

text: Ensure post-adopted children are able to remain in contact with people they love Ensure children who are adopted have the option to stay in touch with the people they love if it is safe to do so; such as Foster Carers, Siblings or Grandparents.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Stop taxing overtime, work beyond 40 hours a week or outside contracted hours We want the government to stop income tax and national insurance contributions on income that is regarded as overtime, outside contracted hours or past 40 hours per week.
label: HM Treasury

text: Give British homeless same legal protection from destitution as asylum seekers Give homeless UK citizens, including veterans, the same legal right to housing and financial support as asylum seekers. No one should be left destitute in their own country. Legal protections would help vulnerable citizens rebuild their lives with dignity.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Reinstate the death penalty for Treason Treason strikes at the very heart of a nation’s survival. Those who knowingly betray their country, aid its enemies, or undermine its security and place every citizen at risk.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Introduce standards for answers to PMQs to be enforced by the Speaker Introduce clear standards for Prime Minister’s Questions requiring that answers address the substance of the question asked. Empower the Speaker to identify when questions have not been substantively answered and to request a follow-up response, either orally or in writing.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Toughen up the law to ensure stricter punishment for child sexual abuse material We think the Government must do everything they can to discourage those who watch child sexual abuse material by changing the law to introduce tougher punishments.
label: Home Office

text: Do not scrap the Work Capability Assessment (WCA) The Government must immediately withdraw the proposal to scrap the WCA, as detailed in its Pathways to Work: Reforming Benefits and Support to Get Britain Working Green Paper.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Require online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance Require online marketplaces to verify that sellers offering precious metal jewellery to UK consumers hold a valid UK Assay Office registration or proof of UK hallmarking compliance before permitting listings describing items as gold, silver, platinum or palladium.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Introduce extensive teaching on deforestation to curriculum for all school ages We think that deforestation is one of the most critical concerns of our generation and is harming ecosystems and threatening biodiversity.
label: Department for Education

text: Review & strengthen DBS checks for risks, create lifetime safeguarding records I want the Government to review and strengthen DBS checks. Implement national pattern-recognition, improve cross-agency information sharing, create lifetime safeguarding records and automatic alerts to avoid missing repeated allegations or risks when people work with children or vulnerable adults.
label: Home Office

text: Hold a national referendum on the UK’s diplomatic relationship with Israel. We call on the Government to hold a national referendum on the UK's relationship with Israel. We think this would allow the British public to decide whether to continue current relations in light of the concerns many have about Israel’s actions.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban herbicides containing Glyphosate to protect people, food and the environment Glyphosate, an ingredient in herbicides, is sprayed on non-organic crops to eliminate weeds and accelerate the drying process before harvest.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund history teachers free/discounted entry to historical sites We call on the Government to fund a national scheme offering history teachers free or discounted access to museums, heritage sites and exhibitions through the implementation of a history teacher ID card.
label: Department for Education

text: Hold an automatic general election on resignation of any Prime Minister. When in opposition Labour demanded a general election following the resignations of PM, Theresa May, Boris Johnson and Liz Truss. We think it is only right now that they are in government they should legislate for this.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Do not introduce the Vaping Products Duty Stop the introduction of the Vaping Products Duty in 2026. We want the Government to halt any new tax on e-liquids and vape products, including 0mg nicotine-free options, to protect small UK vape retailers and manufacturers from closure.
label: HM Treasury

text: Create an Open Work Visa for Skilled Workers after 3 years We ask the Government to introduce an Open Work Visa for those on the Skilled Worker visa, after 3 years, with the ability to renew yearly until ILR eligibility. We believe this could improve mobility, reduce exploitation, and allow skilled workers to contribute more fully to the UK economy.
label: Home Office

text: Refuse ability to claim asylum for convicted criminals We think people convicted of crimes are claiming asylum, but we think once they are found to have a criminal background they should be immediately deported. We think this could free up the time for what we consider to be genuine cases for asylum.
label: Home Office

text: Mandate clear labelling of Coconut Oil and Palm Kernel Oil on food products Clearly label MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglyceride), such as Coconut Oil and Palm Kernel Oil on products for consumption.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Require recycling facilities for blister packs in all dispensaries and chemists I want the government to reduce the amount of blister packs going into landfill by making it possible for people to recycle their medication packaging at the outlet which dispenses it.
label: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

text: Fund healthcare framework and pathways for adults with Cerebral Palsy Adults with Cerebral Palsy face worsening symptoms and high rates of co-morbidities, yet there's no dedicated healthcare framework for them to ensure access to coordinated, specialist-led healthcare provision.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Immediately pause Pathfinder Courts roll-out to hold independent public inquiry Pause the national rollout of Pathfinder/Child Focused Courts and launch an independent public inquiry into the family justice system, including CAFCASS, social services, judges, legal professionals, safeguarding failures, human rights breaches, and compliance with UK law.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Fund private healthcare for gynaecology wait list to clear the NHS backlog Reduce suffering by providing targeted funding for the use of private facilities and surgeons to reduce the surgery wait list time for those with chronic gynaecological conditions such as endometriosis, adenomyosis and PCOS.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban access to legal aid funds for illegal migrant appeals This petition calls on the Government to prohibit access to legal aid funding for asylum appeals following a rejected claim, which would help ensure that individuals whose claims have been fully assessed and refused are removed from the UK without delay.
label: Home Office

text: Create a legal right for adults in hospital care to a named advocate  Legally ensure every adult patient has the right to a named advocate or support person with them throughout their hospital stay, similar to rights given to children.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Launch a rural proofing review & suspend the use of the grey-belt test Launch a rural proofing review into the grey-belt test and completely suspend the use of the grey-belt test for villages for all planning applications pending the outcome.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Amend the Pet Abduction Act to include horses I urge the government to consider horses as pets when it comes to the Pet Abduction Act.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Pass a new 'Freedom of Speech Protection Act' Pass a new act which I believe could help define and protect lawful, non-violent, free speech from censorship by the state or tech companies in a broader, more detailed way than existing laws.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Revise the Current 'Right to Repair' regulations We demand that the UK Government revise the current ‘right to repair’ regulations to include smartphones, cordless phones, tablets, and laptops.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Free school meals for all children I think it is unfair that many families that work have to pay for their children’s school meals when already paying a significant amount of tax every month.
label: Department for Education

text: Abolish leasehold ownership We call for the abolition of leasehold ownership in the UK. England and Wales are some of the few countries who adhere to this system of property ownership. We believe abolishing leasehold ownership would liberate leaseholders from this type of ownership which we view as outdated.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Stop defining state pensions as a benefit We want the Government to change the legal definition of state pensions and stop defining them as a benefit because we believe they are an Annuity paid for with national insurance contributions made by the person accepting the Annuity so in effect it was a way of saving for a pension.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Review SWE processes & the Fitness to Practice guidance Review the Fitness to Practice processes, to ensure staff are adequately trained, reduce the volume of cases passed to case examiners, ensure hearings are kept for those whose fitness to practice is actually impaired. We think this would reduce timescales and reducing costs to social workers and SWE
label: Department for Education

text: Fund more financial support for Counselling Psychology Doctorate I would like financial support for trainee counselling psychologists to be the same as trainee clinical psychologists: tuition fee funded and salary equivalent to NHS Band 6.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make Daylight Saving Time Permanent in the UK I want the government to make Daylight Saving Time Permanent in the UK, as I believe changing clocks leads to confusion, can disrupt daily routines and can harm mental health.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Introduce an offence to the Highways Act for failure to maintain public roads Drivers and owners of vehicles used on the public highway can commit an offence if their vehicle is not maintained in a roadworthy condition. Introduce a similar legal offence to the Highways Act to prosecute responsible Authorities for failure to maintain the roads they are responsible for.
label: Department for Transport

text: Body cameras for all social workers to enhance accountability We think requiring all social workers to wear body cameras would enhance accountability and transparency. We think this would ensure that all actions taken by social workers are just, honest, and free of personal bias or manipulation.
label: Department for Education

text: Make violence against transport workers a specific criminal offence We call on the Government to make violence against transport workers a specific criminal offence in England and Wales. Transport workers can experience high levels of violence and abuse, putting their safety at risk, which must be stopped.
label: Department for Transport

text: Make Nakba education part of the national curriculum I believe the recent war in Gaza is a wake up call to the dehumanisation of Palestinians and injustices they face. I propose to make teaching about the Nakba part of the national curriculum. I believe this will help ensure this never happens again and will help Palestinians to finally have justice.
label: Department for Education

text: Ban the use of driver-facing cameras in HGVs and company vehicles Ban the use of driver-facing cameras in HGVs and company vehicles. We think these cameras invade drivers’ privacy, breach data protection principles, and harm mental health without clear safety benefits. Only road-facing or external cameras should be allowed.
label: Department for Transport

text: Remove parental responsibility from people convicted of DV with 10+ yr sentence We think that any person convicted of serious sexual and/or violent offence(s) against another person with whom they share a child or children and receive a substantial custodial sentence of ten years or more, should automatically lose parental responsibility of said child or children.
label: Ministry of Justice

text:
Hold a consultation & publish a national strategy for foreign language teaching We call on Government to consult with language teachers across all educational levels & use this evidence to develop a modern national strategy for foreign language teaching.

This strategy should address curriculum content, assessment methods, & the level of difficulty in language qualifications.
label: Department for Education

text: Ringfence NHS funding & review clinical training for women’s health conditions Ringfence NHS funding and review clinical training for all women’s health conditions. This should comprehensively cover severe menstrual health, pregnancy, menopause, and all chronic pain, fatigue, or autoimmune ailments that disproportionately affect women.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban the media from allowing online comments about deceased prisoners Ban online comments from being switched on regarding articles related to prisoners' death on social media. This would help prevent further trauma to the families of the deceased especially in cases involving homicide/suicide.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Make Carbohydrate Labelling Mandatory in all Restaurants and food establishments Please consider advocating for legislation that makes the display of carbohydrate content compulsory for restaurant meals, in the same way that calorie labelling is currently mandated. This practical change would make eating out safer and more inclusive for thousands of people across the country.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Automatic ban of abusers' custody of children bereaved by domestic abuse suicide We call on the UK Government to introduce legislation that explicitly prohibits perpetrators of domestic abuse from being granted custody or unsupervised access to their children if it has been established that their abuse has likely contributed to the other parents suicide.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Exempt workers over 60 from National Insurance payments We urge the Government to exempt workers over 60 from paying National Insurance (NI), in order to make it easier financially for older people to survive.
label: HM Treasury

text: Require daily sports in schools and increase school sports funding We want the government to mandate daily physical education in schools, provide more funds for sports programs, and ensure trained teachers/coaches lead activities.
label: Department for Education

text: Limit council tax increases to the lowest of either inflation or 5% Limit council tax increases to the lowest of either inflation or 5%
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text:
Introduce harsher penalties for causing death by careless driving We call on the UK Government to reform the law on causing death by careless driving, including:

- Setting harsher minimum sentencing
- Requiring immediate driving bans upon charge
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Fund a Children & Young People’s Cancer Diagnosis Awareness Campaign According to the NHS, 3,755 people under 25 are diagnosed with cancer per year and it is the most common cause of death by disease for UK children. We urge the Government to fund a national awareness campaign for children and young people, as we believe this would help to promote earlier diagnosis.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Preserve digital terrestrial television distribution to save Freeview  The Government’s White Paper on the future of TV distribution in the UK sets out its proposals to switch to internet-only TV in future. This is likely to have an impact on anyone living in a poor Internet location as it will end the current Freeview service.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Ban MPs from having second jobs except in NHS MPs should not have other jobs outside of Parliament unless they are qualified doctors, nurses or other healthcare professionals and actively work in the NHS
label: Cabinet Office

text: Regulate veterinary care costs to improve affordability & accessibility We believe veterinary costs have risen significantly in recent years, placing financial pressure on pet owners and risking animal welfare when treatment becomes unaffordable.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text:
Ban compulsory purchase orders in redevelopment: protect homes & communities
 We want the Government to ban compulsory purchase orders in redevelopment schemes, protect residents’ rights to stay in their homes, and ensure regeneration is based on voluntary agreements and genuine community-led decision-making that strengthens, not dismantles, local communities.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Change IHT rules to be payable only after probate has been granted We petition the Government to make Inheritance Tax payable only after probate is granted and when sufficient accessible cash is available within a deceased person’s estate to pay the IHT liability.
label: HM Treasury

text: Ban dogs from indoor restaurants and other premises selling prepared food We believe this measure would improve the management of hygiene and protect people who are averse to dogs.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Call for the UK to Withdraw from the 1951 Refugee Convention We, the undersigned, call on the UK Government to withdraw from the 1951 Refugee Convention and its 1967 Protocol. We think the current asylum system is outdated and no longer fits the challenges our country faces today.
label: Home Office

text: Make the climate emergency a lawful excuse in criminal cases Make the climate emergency a lawful excuse in criminal damage and other such cases.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Ban under 16s from being featured in social media content Ban the publication and sharing of images and videos on social media featuring children under 16 years old. We believe children should not be used as content.
label: Department for Education

text: Call for a national referendum on Net Zero – a simple yes or no We urge the Government to pass a law on holding a referendum on Net Zero, to give the people the opportunity to say whether they agree with this agenda or not, as we believe it could hurt the UK economy and people’s livelihoods.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Ban all peanuts and tree nuts on all flights to protect allergy sufferers Create legislation to ban all peanuts and tree nuts on all flights, including those served by airlines and brought by passengers. We think this would protect people with severe allergies from life-threatening reactions in a setting where emergency medical help isn't available.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Establish National Taskforce to Deliver Inclusive, Joined up SEND Reform There’s currently no cross-government body leading SEND reform. We think we need urgent action that brings education, health, families and professionals together, protects legal rights, and embeds joined-up leadership from day one to stop children falling through the cracks.
label: Department for Education

text: Make bodycams and improved restraining training compulsory for SIA staff We call on the Government to make it compulsory for all SIA staff to wear bodycams and for improved restraining training to be introduced for all SIA staff, in order to prevent death or serious injury to members of the public.
label: Home Office

text: Hold a referendum on devolution and a new nation in the North of England We want the Government to hold a referendum on devolution to a new Northern English nation on par with Scotland and Scottish devolution.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Pass a law that schools cannot prohibit the use of personal devices Ban schools from prohibiting, restricting or confiscating any personal digital devices like phones or laptops. We believe they are essential tools, not distractions, and that schools must adapt. We believe students deserve protection of property, privacy, and digital rights.
label: Department for Education

text: Ban UK visas for citizens of countries who don’t take back illegal migrants A large proportion of illegal migrants in the UK are economic migrants. We believe they must be returned to their country of origin to prevent further cost to the public purse.
label: Home Office

text: Free hospital parking for all NHS staff in England  We think NHS staff should not have to pay to park on-site at hospitals. Staff don’t have to pay to park in Wales or Scotland. We want free parking for NHS staff please!
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Commercial Pilot Training to be VAT exempt and introduce new funding options I am urging the Government to make all commercial pilot training fees VAT exempt and provide government-backed loans or grants for aspiring pilots. I believe that this would lower financial barriers which in turn would promote diversity and provide a sustainable future for the aviation industry.
label: Department for Education

text: Scrap the 2-child benefit cap We think the government should scrap the two-child benefit cap to support struggling families as we think this policy pushes many children into poverty and worsens inequality. We think scrapping the cap would provide vital support, alleviate hardship, and ensure equal opportunities for all children.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Set rules about when a service/venue can describe itself as accessible Amend the Equality Act 2010 to prevent a venue or service describing themselves as 'accessible' without describing in what way it is accessible, i.e. what the accessibility features are.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Review shared care arrangements for ADHD between NHS and private specialists Review shared care arrangements for ADHD where a patient has been diagnosed and stabilised by a qualified specialist, including appropriately qualified private specialists and via the Right to Choose pathway, to ensure consistent access to medication and continuity of care by the NHS.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: All military veterans to be exempted from tax on their military pensions  Studies show that some people leave the forces without access to adequate benefits, placing immense pressure on families and, in some cases, leading to homelessness or suicide.
label: HM Treasury

text: Work with devolved governments to extend the grooming gangs inquiry Work with devolved governments to extend the national inquiry into group based child sexual exploitation to Scotland and Northern Ireland. We think this is a form of group based child sexual abuse which has been significantly neglected, and which is at risk of becoming worse.
label: Home Office

text: Legalise use of privately owned e-scooters and e-bikes on public roads Legalise the use of electric bikes and scooters for use of the public.
label: Department for Transport

text: Regulate Cabin Baggage Dimensions Across Airlines and Cap Baggage Fees We want the Government to regulate and standardise cabin baggage dimensions across all airlines operating in the UK and introduce regulations to cap fees for baggage charges. We think this would prevent airlines from imposing inconsistent and exploitative policies on passengers.
label: Department for Transport

text: Legalise the use of e-scooters for under 16s on public roads We think that e-scooters help young people get around cheaply and safely. With the right rules, we think they could be legal for 16s with no need for a licence.
label: Department for Transport

text: Legalise euthanasia for late onset Dementia I would like the Government to legalise euthanasia for people suffering with late onset Dementia. I think people should be able to decide the quality of life they want.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Remove false accusations involving children services from parents’ records We want the Government to legislate to automatically remove any accusations proven to be false as a result of previous investigations from parents' children’s services records, so that parents do not have to declare an involvement in the past with social services on future hospital, etc visits.
label: Department for Education

text: Exempt all persons convicted of any sexual/violent offences from early release We call on the UK Government to amend the Sentencing Act so that all individuals convicted of any sexual or violent offence are ineligible for any form of early automatic release scheme or brought-forward release dates.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Do not increase the time migrants with ILR need to wait to apply for citizenship We ask the Government and Parliament not to amend the British Nationality Act 1981 to increase the qualifying period for migrants with indefinite leave to remain (ILR) to become eligible to apply for British citizenship.
label: Home Office

text: New legislation: ensure informed consent is always given to avoid patient harm. Update the law to ensure informed consent is mandatory before ALL medical and cosmetic surgeries/procedures/treatments, and before prescriptions are written. Legislation must ensure all known risks are declared to the patient. Failure to comply resulting in needless injury must be prosecutable.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Appoint a Minister of State for Water Safety We want the Government to appoint a Minister of State for Water Safety. The Minister should ensure water safety standards are adhered to, warnings are put out all year-round, so landowners take responsibility for their land/bodies of water, and adequate signage & safety equipment are in place.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Fund more gender-affirming care on the NHS and increase staff training Improve access to gender-affirming healthcare by reducing waiting times, allowing trained providers to prescribe care directly, and ensuring all GPs receive proper training on transgender health.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Extend parental bereavement leave to 4 weeks after the loss of a child Currently, bereavement leave for parents after the loss of a child is two weeks. We believe this is not enough time to begin to grieve or plan and have the funeral before returning to work. We want to get the law changed so parents have more time to grieve after such a huge loss.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Make bullying a specific criminal offence We would like the government to make bullying a specific criminal offence. We do not want it to come under harassment and employment laws or other offences.
label: Home Office

text: Legalise spray, tasers & airguns for self-defence & require businesses hold them We should be allowed to prepare to defend ourselves and those around us, I want to legalise the use and carry of pepper spray and tasers and also allow the use of less lethal airguns in your home. We feel that we can prepare for every worst scenario except for defending ourselves.
label: Home Office

text: Government to maintain VAT relief on repairs for historic churches We urgently call on the Government to maintain the Listed Places of Worship Grant Scheme (LPWGS) and VAT relief on church repairs. Not doing so, we believe, adds a 20% tax burden on struggling congregations, threatening historic churches and signalling reduced support for Christian institutions.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Hold a referendum on assisted dying We believe a referendum on assisted dying is necessary to ensure that a decision of such profound moral, ethical, and societal importance reflects the informed will of the public, rather than being debated by parliament and appearing to be filibustered by the House of Lords.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make it mandatory for all dogs to be on leads in public places. We want to stop dogs being off lead in public places so that children are able to play freely. We think this would stop dogs off lead running up to other dogs that are on lead, which we feel causes unnecessary stress.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund routine Prostate Cancer screening Having just lost my husband to Prostate Cancer, I want routine screening to be available where this menace silent illness could be prevalent. We think prevention is an absolute priority to young men at risk, regardless of symptoms or not.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Fund a dedicated family support team for all missing children cases As the mother of Ben Needham, I know the pain of no answers. Families face unequal support. We call on the UK Government to fund a centralised team to ensure fair, equal help for all missing children cases. so no family fights alone.
label: Home Office

text: Donate migrant boats to Ukraine It seems that it costs the British taxpayer to store these boats and engines in Dover and at other facilities. Confiscated from people smugglers, we believe they should be repurposed by donating to the Ukrainian Military for use in defence and rescue missions on Dnipro and other Ukrainian rivers.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Scrap Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax and remove £200 fine The Government should scrap the new Making Tax Digital (MTD) scheme for Income Tax and revert to the previous system where Self Employed People handed in accounts once a Year. We also call on the Government to drop the £200 fines for late submissions and requirement to upload information online.
label: HM Treasury

text: Make it illegal for 18+ adults to have sex with under 18s Keep the legal age of consent at 16, but make it illegal for adults aged 18 or over to have sexual activity with anyone under 18. This could protect minors from grooming and adult exploitation while still allowing legal relationships between peers aged 16–17.
label: Home Office

text: Consult on and negotiate a youth mobility scheme with the EU We feel many young people, born EU citizens, lost key rights post Brexit and many may have been unable to vote in 2016. As the Government considers a youth mobility scheme, we think it must consult young people to ensure their needs are met, with access to the same opportunities as prior generations
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Reinstate the Winter Fuel Allowance for those who are paid the old state pension We believe the Chancellor of the Exchequer should reinstate the Winter Fuel Allowance for pensioners on the old state pension who are not eligible for state benefits.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Require a mental health alert symbol on patient records Mental health must be treated as medical urgency. I call for an addition to patient records: a red circle with a brain symbol to identify those at high mental health risk. This could help healthcare staff recognise danger quickly, respond faster, and prevent missed warning signs and tragic outcomes.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: MPs repeatedly failing to disclose financial declaration on time to be suspended Reform MPs’ financial disclosure rules so repeated late declarations automatically trigger Standards Committee referral and suspension. We believe this would ensure patterns of non-compliance have real consequences, including recall where thresholds are met.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Revoke asylum for Syrian Refugees in light of the change of Government With the change of Government in Syria we call upon the UK Government to follow Austria's example and draw up plans for the repatriation and deportation of Syrian refugees.
label: Home Office

text: Ban greyhound racing We want the government to ban greyhound racing.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund AMH testing in the NHS and improve IVF access for low AMH women Fund AMH testing as part of standard NHS fertility checks. Provide NHS IVF funding for women with low AMH, regardless of age or partner’s parental status. Allow patients to stop a cycle with less than 3 follicles without losing NHS entitlement.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Require Local Authorities to provide more notice for care funding rates Every year social care providers and charities wait for news of the change to funding rates set by Local Authorities. Sometimes they don’t hear till after the new financial year has started, which makes it impossible to follow governance processes with Trustees or to budget properly.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Introduce a rehoming scheme for banned breeds Establish a Rehoming Scheme specifically tailored for rehoming banned breed dogs that are of good temperament.  Collaborate with rescue charities and organisations, ensuring that potential adopters undergo thorough screening and education on responsible dog ownership.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund guaranteed paid community work shifts via Jobcentres Fund a voluntary Community Works Guarantee allowing Jobcentres to offer paid shifts tackling community needs such as cleaning and maintenance.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Change family law proceedings burden of proof to “beyond a reasonable doubt” In family law proceedings judges make decisions based on a standard of proof based on a balance of probabilities that something is more likely than not to have happened, and we think this should be changed in line with criminal law so that it must be proven “beyond a reasonable doubt”.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: End slaughter of animals without prior stunning in the UK We call on the UK Government to require that all animals are rendered unconscious before slaughter, without exception.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Review state education and students’ wellbeing, especially for children with SEN We think the Education system has become too focused on statistics, affecting many children’s experiences in a detrimental mental, emotional and physical way and should be reviewed. We think the review should also consider how neurodivergent and children with SEN can achieve their potential.
label: Department for Education

text: Use frozen Russian assets now to fund urgent aid and reconstruction in Ukraine Ukrainians are enduring prolonged power outages lasting days. We ask the Government to use frozen Russian assets to fund provision of immediate humanitarian relief, support reconstruction, and ensure responsibility for the damage lies with the state that caused it.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Petition for UK Defensive Border & Rear‑Area Logistics Support to Ukraine We ask UK Gov, subject to Ukr’s invitation, deploy non‑combat UK teams to W. and N. Ukr to secure rear areas, protect civilians, deter & doc cross‑border incursions, & sustain humanitarian corridors. This would be lawful, aligned with NATO sp mechs & IHL & free Ukr forces for front‑line defence.
label: Ministry of Defence

text: Ban MPs who resign with open standards investigations from standing as an MP MPs that resign and therefore escape open parliamentary standards investigations should be banned from standing as an MP, unless the investigations are resumed and completed whilst they are not in office.
label: Office of the Leader of the House of Commons

text: Require employers to pay carers for travel time and all hours worked Many carers are not paid for travel time between service users, even though it is part of their working day. This means some carers work long hours but are only paid for contact time. We think this is unfair, lowers real pay and risks carers' salaries falling below minimum wage.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Scrap the cap on medical training & increase funding We call on the Government to scrap the cap on medical training places. Abolish these limits and increase funding for more placements and trainers, and to widen access, reduce reliance on overseas recruitment, and ensure any needs are met.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Statutory sick pay from day 1 of absence for those with chronic illness We think the government needs to introduce better support for those with chronic illnesses, including statutory sick pay for any time off relating to the illness from the first day of being off sick. We think those who can provide evidence of a chronic condition should not have to financially suffer
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Increase support for children affected from being bullied We believe children are having suicidal thoughts, ptsd, Trauma as a result of bullying. We think more mental health support needs to be available for victims of bullying in schools.
label: Department for Education

text: Uprate state pensions for all UK pensioners living overseas Many UK citizens have emigrated to other countries, like Canada, and now are retired and rely on their UK state pensions for financial support. Only pensioners living in the US, EU and some other countries that the UK has a bilateral social security agreement with have their state pensions uprated.
label: HM Treasury

text: Pause NHS Neighbourhood plans, protect local GP surgeries & hold consultation Pause the rollout of Neighbourhood Health reforms. Hold a full public consultation, publish detailed implementation plans, commit to protecting GP surgeries, and formally commit to and guarantee that no contracts will be handed to private companies or overstretched hospital trusts.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Increase police funding to tackle organised house robberies We want the Government to increase police funding to give them more capacity to prioritise and take decisive action against organised house robbery gangs, improve response times and investigations, increase policing in high-risk areas, and take tougher action against repeat offenders.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Review consent law to protect neurodivergent people from miscarriages of justice We ask the Government to review consent law to ensure courts and juries consider neurodivergence and relationship context when judging belief in consent. Neurodivergent people need fair legal protections to prevent miscarriages of justice in sexual offence cases.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Recognise Jerusalem as the capital city of Israel Given the appalling terrorist attack in Manchester on the back of rising antisemitism in the UK, I contend that it is time the UK government recognise Jerusalem as the capital of the State of Israel and move the UK Embassy and Consulate there.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban isolation in schools I believe there is an urgent need to ban isolation in schools. I consider such practices harm vulnerable students, including autistic children, violating their rights and well-being and schools must adopt inclusive, supportive strategies to ensure a safe, nurturing environment for all children.
label: Department for Education

text: Automatic driving ban until driving test retake for 12 Points on a Licence. Make it an automatic driving ban until you retake your driving test when you reach 12 points on your driving licence. We think having some people with over 30 points still driving, makes a Mockery of the Law and is a Danger to others on our Roads.
label: Department for Transport

text: Change law regarding owners giving up their dogs We don't think owners have enough rights to reclaim their dog once it's been relinquished, even if they regret the decision, misunderstand the agreement, or are scammed.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Urge the Nigerian government to protect Nigerian Christians We call on the UK Government to strongly urge the Nigerian authorities to protect Christian communities facing violence. It’s been reported that over 7,000 Christians were killed in Nigeria this year.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban fishing in 30% of the UK’s coastal waters to allow marine ecosystem recovery In June, there will be a UN Ocean Conference, where Governments will discuss a 30% no fishing policy. We urge the Government to ban fishing in 30% of the UK’s coastal waters to lead the way in restoring the health of our oceans and fish stocks for future generations.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Cancel the consultation on “In-use emissions of road vehicles” We believe the consultation for the "In-use emissions of road vehicles: regulating environmental impacts" is a pretext for taking many internal combustion engine cars off the road and pushing car ownership outside the financial reach of millions of taxpayers. We want the consultation cancelled.
label: Department for Transport

text: Create and fund a support system for dog attack victims Those attacked by dogs can be left with fear, nightmares and lasting trauma. Families can face huge gaps in care following dog attacks. We need a national trauma support service so victims aren’t left alone.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Mandate a stand-alone VAWG policy in all secondary schools & colleges in England Require all secondary schools and colleges in England to have a mandatory Violence Against Women and Girls policy by September 2027 as a legal requirement, including staff training, incident recording, published data and reporting routes.
label: Department for Education

text: Require bereavement support in all private pregnancy scan clinics We are calling for a legal requirement that at least one fully trained member of staff in bereavement and pregnancy loss support is present at all times in private scan clinics, with the knowledge to guide families through their next steps.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban cousin marriage Make it illegal for people to marry and have children with their cousins.
label: Home Office

text: Increase Research Funding and Improve Treatment for Interstitial Cystitis (IC) We want the government to increase funding for IC research to better understand its causes and develop effective treatments. We also want them to provide training and resources for healthcare professionals to improve diagnosis and care.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: A nationwide referendum on reinstating the death penalty for child sexual abuse We want the British public to have a say on whether the most serious child sexual abuse offences should be punishable by death or be tax-funded with life imprisonment.
label: Home Office

text: Make petrol and diesel tax free Stop taxing petrol and diesel. Freedom of movement is a fundamental human right. We believe the petrol and diesel combustion engine is what fuels our freedom and we shouldn’t be taxed on one of our basic human rights.
label: HM Treasury

text: Use diplomatic influence to help get baby formula into Gaza We want the Government to urgently speak to Israel to ensure baby formula can get in to Gaza, including to infants and babies in hospitals who are suffering from malnutrition. Reports say the blockade is causing a shortage of formula.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Create a regulatory body to regulate and oversee estate management companies We call for the creation of a regulatory body to oversee estate management companies, to help ensure transparency, accountability, and fair service charges for leaseholders and freeholders. We think it’s time to better protect residents’ rights.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Install fences and barriers on bridges over motorways to help prevent suicide Suicides or attempted suicides can create traffic chaos, which can then create more mental health issues. Install fences to keep people from attempting suicide from  motorway bridges.
label: Department for Transport

text: Legally classify the creation & use of sexual deep fakes as sexual assault We think that if a person creates a pornographic deep fake it should be classified as sexual assault, as AI use is rising and the use of deep fakes to depict women and girls performing sexual acts is on the rise.
label: Home Office

text: Political parties to be funded only by membership fees and a government grant Change the law so that all political party funding is exclusively by capped membership fees and an equal government grant to all registered parties.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Prevent people convicted of serious crimes standing or serving as MPs  Ban anyone who has ever been convicted of serious offences (such as sex offences against children, terrorism, serious fraud, corruption, violent crimes) including foreign convictions and given a custodial or suspended sentence from standing for or serving as an MP; when appeals have been exhausted.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Legislate that bin collections cannot be more than two weeks apart. We think there should be an act of parliament that bin collections cannot be more than two weeks apart.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Fund specialised psychological therapies for all NHS Mental Health inpatients Providing funding to make specialised therapy such as CBT, DBT, and trauma-focused therapy available to all NHS psychiatric inpatients. Ensure every patient gets tailored psychological treatment alongside medication if appropriate rather than these vital services only being accessible post-discharge
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Increase funding for hospice care facilities There are reports of hospice care charities being forced to cut staff and available beds for patients. We want the Government to increase the funding and support they’re allocated. Dying should be dignified and personal and hospices can provide this.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Require monitoring & response within 72 hrs to children at risk due to bullying Require schools, local councils, CAMHS and safeguarding services to monitor & share information when a child is at risk due to severe bullying. We believe this must be treated as a safeguarding issue, and parents must be informed. This should be known as Ollie’s law.
label: Department for Education

text: Review KCSIE to protect trans and intersex students' rights We think the Keeping Children Safe in Education 2026 guidance is unsafe for trans youth and should be reviewed. For example, mandating active parental involvement in most cases, setting a binary criteria & requiring provision of single-sex toilet facilities unless self-contained individual toilets.
label: Wales Office

text: End routine PIP reassessments for people with lifelong & progressive conditions We want the Government to end routine Personal Independence Payment (PIP) reassessments for people with lifelong, progressive or irreversible conditions where there is no realistic prospect of significant improvement. Most chronic illness' worsen over time / remain unchanged from initial assessment.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Mandate registration with a recognised regulatory body for all personal trainers The Government must act to introduce a protected title of Registered Personal Trainer, require registration with a professional body, enforce qualifications, and create a national safeguarding register. We believe this will improve safety, accountability, and trust across the fitness industry.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Require councils to give everyone a month off of paying council tax We want the government to give everyone a month off from paying council tax. We are concerned that there are potholes on the roads, roads have been left ungritted and household waste has sometimes not been collected.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Ban the sale of vapes within a 1km radius of schools We call on the Government to ban the sale of vapes, and ban new vape shops opening, within 1km of schools. This could reduce youth exposure to nicotine products, support public health, strengthen safeguarding, and help prevent underage vaping and addiction among children and teenagers.
label: Department for Education

text: Require accessible social housing to be available to disabled people of any age Require social housing providers to allow all disabled people to access ground-floor flats/bungalows blocks, regardless of age.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Bring all social care into the public sector, under the NHS & stop means testing We demand the new government bring all Social and Community Care under the NHS, fully funded by general taxation. We think neither Social Care, Community Care, nor the NHS should be for-profit, but remain free at the point of use.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Create independent body to regulate pay practices for private hire drivers We ask the Government to create an independent regulatory authority for the private hire sector. This regulation should ensure fair pay structures for drivers, set fair minimum fares, cap commission, and protect drivers from unfair practices by private hire operators.
label: Department for Transport

text: Automatic Mandatory Penalties if Local Authorities miss Statutory SEND deadlines Figures show nearly all parents in England forced to go to SEND tribunal win, and the number of SEND tribunals has risen. The government should hold Local Authorities legally responsible for families' emotional distress, ensuring automatic penalties for those that miss statutory SEND deadlines.
label: Department for Education

text: Fund all NHS hospital parking through general taxation and abolish visitor fees We believe hospital parking charges hit the poor, sick & and NHS staff unfairly. The Government should fund the costs of this from general taxation so NHS car parks are free at use. To prevent non-patient abuse, in-clinic digital validation kiosks could bill the Department of Health directly.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make it law that all public trains have working CCTV at all times. Introduce a legal requirement for all public passenger trains to have working CCTV whenever in service, with standardised retention periods and guaranteed police access, to improve investigations and protect women and girls from sexual offences.
label: Department for Transport

text: Make coercive or controlling behaviour leading to suicide a specific offence Domestic violence and coercive control can destroy lives, sometimes driving victims to suicide. Yet the law fails to recognise this as a specific criminal offence.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Require trauma informed specialist advocate for victims reporting domestic abuse Require that victims are given a trauma-informed specialist advocate, separate from an IDVA or appropriate adult, who will support them in person when: reporting abuse; getting help from mental health services and; navigating the system ensuring their abuse, risk, trauma and safety are understood.
label: Home Office

text: Stop ALL legal aid for non British citizens unless worked in UK for 10 years Stop Legal Aid for non British citizens exceptions would be if you have worked and paid Tax in the UK for at least 10 years continuously
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Ban bank charges for charities Legislate to ban all bank charges on charity’s accounts to allow these funds to be used to support the purpose the charity gathers them for, rather than bolster bank profits.
label: HM Treasury

text: Mandate standardised Trans HRT pescribing training for all NHS GPs Many NHS GPs will not offer shared care for hormone pescribing for Trans patients who are under the care of a NHS GIC (Gender Identity clinic). In many cases, many of them cite not having training, or adequate training to do so.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Hold a public inquiry into claims & information made in the EU Exit Referendum We call on the UK Government to establish an independent, public inquiry into the claims and information presented during the EU Exit referendum. Many reports and studies suggest that misleading or exaggerated claims were made by both sides, which may have influenced public opinion and the result.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Increase 30 free hours childcare availability to cover 52 weeks per year Increase the current offer of 30 free hours of childcare per week to cover 52 weeks instead of 38 weeks per year.
label: Department for Education

text: Public inquiry into illegal immigration We call on the Government to launch a full-scale public inquiry into illegal immigration into the UK. The inquiry should investigate the effectiveness of UK border control, the financial cost on taxpayers, and the deportation system.
label: Home Office

text: Protect UK citizens’ living in the EU right to home fee status & loan access We call on the Government to scrap plans to remove university home fee status and student loan access from British citizens living in the EU from 2028. This could financially discourage EU-based UK citizens from studying in the UK. Often, one or both parents have paid into the UK tax system.
label: Department for Education

text: Ban palm oil in all food that is sold and manufactured in the UK We call on the government to introduce legislation to ban palm oil as an ingredient in all foods manufactured or sold in the UK. This should include a phased transition period for businesses to reformulate products using more sustainable and locally sourced or low impact alternative oils.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Require all dogs to be kept on leads in public places To bring in legislation that requires all dogs to be kept on leads in public places with a fine imposed if not adhered to.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Abolish Stamp Duty to Make Homeownership More Accessible for All We call on the UK Government to abolish Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) on residential property purchases. We think stamp Duty is an outdated tax that discourages mobility, penalises homebuyers—especially growing families—and adds unnecessary barriers to homeownership.
label: HM Treasury

text: Require DBS checks for delivery drivers We call on the UK Government to make it mandatory for all delivery drivers—including those working for gig economy platforms—to undergo at least a Basic DBS check.  We believe this would help to prevent exploitation and protect public safety.
label: Home Office

text: Conduct review into NHS recognition, diagnosis & treatment of cluster headaches Cluster headaches are among the most severe pain conditions but are often misdiagnosed and under-treated in the NHS. We feel the name fails to reflect their extreme, disabling nature, reducing urgency. Patients can face delays, poor access to oxygen therapy, and limited specialist care.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Amend avian flu regulations to allow the vaccination of swans and wildfowl Current legislation only allows birds that are kept in zoological settings to be vaccinated against avian influenza. This should be extended to static populations of swans and wildfowl to prevent these flocks being wiped out this winter. Stratford upon Avon has such a flock of swans at risk.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Mandate publishing annual statistics on data centre water & electricity usage Parts of the UK have experienced a drought, and residents have been asked to conserve water. We are concerned that the concerted efforts to build new data centres could place a huge strain on our water supply.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: All video games must be available to purchase as a physical, complete version Game developers when releasing a new game must provide a physical copy either disc or USB key. This media must be transferable and saleable.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Publicly urge the US Government to end its oil & economic embargo against Cuba We ask the UK Government to publicly call for the end to the US’ economic embargo and measures preventing oil from reaching Cuba, and to raise this through diplomatic channels, including the United Nations and the UK–Cuba Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Allow children whose parents are legally in UK to work as sports professionals Children with permission as dependents of parents who are legally in the UK on a work route, or who have settled in the UK on such a route, cannot be employed as a professional sportsperson unless they are a dependant of a person with UK ancestry.
label: Home Office

text: Withdraw from ECHR & stop processing asylum claims until Channel crossings stop We call on the government to withdraw the UK’s membership of the European Convention on Human Rights and pause processing all asylum applications until illegal Channel crossings are completely stopped.
label: Home Office
