Funding should also support mandated training for healthcare staff, improved testing and timely referrals to meet the 18-week treatment standard.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: NHS-funded rehabilitation to be made more accessible for FND patients I want the Government to make NHS-funded help for FND more widespread so that it can be accessed in more places, such as in Milton Keynes
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban the boiling of live crabs and other crustaceans Ban the boiling or cooking in any form of live crabs, lobsters, and other crustaceans. Imagine being boiled alive with no escape. I believe it is savage.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Require convicted MPs, Peers and Civil Servants to be removed from office When MPs, members of the House of Lords and civil servants are found guilty of a criminal offence, we think they should be removed from office. In the case of MPs, a by-election should be called to find a replacement.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Legally require vegetarian and vegan food to be cooked and prepared separately Legally require all vegetarian and vegan foods in food establishments to be cooked and prepared separately from meat. We believe legal standards are needed to protect people with allergies, medical conditions, or ethical/religious diets and prevent misleading claims.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Grant £10K per year to small retailers facing losses from shoplifting We urge the UK government to provide £10,000 yearly grants to support small retailers affected by rising shoplifting and break-ins. These crimes can cause severe financial losses, and may force businesses to close. We believe urgent action is needed to protect local shops and ensure their survival.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Re-join the Erasmus+ programme for UK students We believe re-joining ERASMUS+ would be an investment in our young people, education, research, the economy, societal wellbeing through fostering international engagement while bolstering the Turing scheme.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Require all Government Ministers to be Elected Members of Parliament We call on the UK Government to change the law so that only people elected in a general election or by-election to the House of Commons may serve as government ministers. No person should be able to become a minister solely through appointment to the House of Lords.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Legislate to ensure public inquiry recommendations lead to action The Government must establish a statutory duty on public bodies covered in the findings or recommendations from public inquiries to report progress regularly on their implementation or set out reasons for such recommendations not being implemented, with other means suggested for remedying failings.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Mandate neurodiversity training for all school staff Introduce mandatory training for all staff in schools, including teachers, to be more aware of neurodiverse children. We believe by doing so we can ensure neurodiverse children get their needs met, so they feel more accepted in school.
label: Department for Education

text: Reintroduce the death penalty for murder We believe the death penalty for murder should be reintroduced based on key principles of justice and public protection.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Protect our freedoms: Ban facial recognition of public We urge the government to ban the use of mass facial recognition technology in public spaces. We believe legislation is needed to protect rights and ensure ethical use of technology.
label: Home Office

text: All schools to have staff to administer glucagon to pupils with Type 1 diabetes Require all schools to have trained staff available to administer prescribed emergency glucagon to pupils with Type 1 diabetes experiencing severe hypoglycaemia.
label: Department for Education

text: Ban horse racing in the UK and fund transition to lifelong horse welfare safely. Pass legislation to prohibit horse racing in the UK, end the commercial use of horses for racing, and create a funded transition plan for horses bred for or leaving racing, including retraining, rehoming, sanctuary placement, retirement care, and enforceable welfare protections during the phase-out.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: All UK homeless citizens should be prioritised for hotel accommodation We believe that no one should be living on the streets. Many of these individuals are ex-servicemen, and support does not seem to be available to everyone in our society. In contrast, millions is spent every day on hotel accommodations for people who have entered the UK illegally.
label: Home Office

text: Reduce salary for MPs who miss over 30% of their votes We call on Parliament to introduce financial sanctions in the form of proportional salary reductions for any who participates in fewer than 70% of Parliamentary divisions, with fair exemptions for the Speaker, illness, parental leave, and official duties.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Require schools to teach British Sign Language from Key Stage 2 & at GCSE Require schools to teach British Sign Language from Key Stage 2 as it could promote inclusion, accessibility and ensure everyone is heard. BSL supports Deaf and SEN children, improves communication for all, and should be available at GCSE level like other language options.
label: Department for Education

text: Register and license all high-powered electric bikes and off-road e-motorbikes We ask the Government to require registration and insurance for all high-powered electric bikes, and to restrict sale of unregistered or untraceable vehicles.
label: Department for Transport

text: Increase funding for information on dangers of high blood pressure in pregnancy Allocate more funding to information about the dangers of high blood pressure during pregnancy. Detailing every single symptom to look out for, and highlighting the dangers, which if missed can sadly lead to fatalities of both mother and child. Placental abruption due to high bp is serious!
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make it illegal for politicians to use false information and statistics We want the Government to introduce a law making it illegal for MPs, ministers, and political parties to knowingly use false or misleading information and statistics in speeches, campaigns, and official documents. There should be clear penalties and accountability for breaches.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Fund an NHS fast-track route for ADHD & autism diagnoses and treatment We urge the Government to fund a fast-track route in the NHS for ADHD and autism diagnoses and treatment, to ensure urgent access to care, regardless of whether diagnosed privately or publicly. We believe no one should face delays, gaps in medication, or be denied essential support.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban insurance companies increasing premiums after no fault claims When someone writes your car off or damages your car, even if the insurance company has paperwork from the other side which proves they are to blame, they may put your car insurance up.
label: HM Treasury

text: Make meningitis vaccination available for free to all We call on the Government to offer free meningitis vaccines to all irrespective of age. Recent university-linked cases show there is an ongoing risk. Many over 25 remain unprotected despite exposure in higher education settings. Universal access would prevent deaths and reduce outbreaks.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make it illegal for DVLA to share vehicle keeper data with private companies Make it illegal for the DVLA to share driver and keeper data with private companies. Drivers should not have their personal information released without consent, especially for use by private parking firms. DVLA data should only be provided to public authorities.
label: Department for Transport

text: Allow all skill level legal immigrants to bring their dependents in the UK Allow all skill level legal immigrants to bring their dependents to stay with their loved family members.
label: Home Office

text:
Explain how the EU advisory referendum became a decision The 2016 referendum was advisory, that point was put beyond question by the Supreme Court judgment. 
We consider that an advisory referendum is an expression of opinion, it is not a declaration of will. 
We cannot see any democratic pathway that enables that opinion to become a decision.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Stop the Government from raising the tuition fee cap I want the Government to maintain the current tuition fee cap. This could help to protect young people and current university students who may be struggling or may struggle financially if tuition fees are raised.
label: Department for Education

text: Fund free oral health checks for people with diabetes as part of NHS care We want the Government to integrate free, routine oral health checks for all diagnosed diabetes patients into NHS diabetes care pathways. This could be delivered through NHS dental services or commissioned screening programmes, with appropriate referral pathways for further treatment where required.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: UK must act now & condemn the killing of Kurdish civilians in Rojava & Rojhilat We urge the UK Government to act immediately to try to stop the killing of Kurdish civilians in Rojava and Rojhilat. The UK must condemn these attacks, raise them at the UN, press Syria and Iran to halt violence, support investigations, impose sanctions, and protect civilians.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban school uniforms I would like the Government to abolish school uniform
label: Department for Education

text: Review the PIP assessment process to adjust for neurodivergence and trauma Review the current PIP Assessment process, including consideration of ensuring health care professionals are trained in trauma informed practice.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Increase the Lifetime ISA house price limit in line with inflation  Adjust the Lifetime ISA house price limit to reflect current market values, allowing first-time buyers in high-cost areas access to homes under this program.
label: HM Treasury

text: Exempt all Pensioners from Council Tax. We call on Parliament to pass a law which exempts all pensioners from paying Council Tax. Current provisions only ensure that pensioners on the lowest incomes receive full relief, yet many others, particularly those on modest but above-threshold incomes, still pay this tax.
label: HM Treasury

text: Prevent all migrants without visas from accessing NHS healthcare for free Review cost of migrants without visas accessing the NHS, as we feel it is unfair that many citizens pay taxes to fund public services like NHS and have to wait for a long time to access care.
label: Home Office

text: Legislate to allow additional vehicle lighting for Community First Responders Legislate to allow volunteer ambulance community responders in trust approved & marked vehicles to use additional lighting ONLY to make progress to category 1 (highest priority) emergency calls. They are volunteers who support their local community by attending medical emergencies.
label: Department for Transport

text: Give women’s health greater priority in the 10-Year Health Plan for England This could involve improving access to specialist care from puberty to post-menopause, training healthcare professionals to better acknowledge and validate women’s symptoms, removing barriers linked to age, race or income, increasing investment, and involving more women in decisions.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Relax the spacing requirements on UK personalised vehicle registration plates In 2012 it was reported that the Government was planning to relax spacing requirements for personalised numberplates, to allow for letters and numbers to be moved closer together to more easily spell words. This planned change has not been implemented.
label: Department for Transport

text: Remove taxes on personal savings & private pensions We the people call on the government to remove the tax paid on personal savings & private pensions.
label: HM Treasury

text: Restore UK Leadership in Global Development – Reverse Aid Cuts The UK is slashing development aid to fund defence—which we think undermines its global leadership & is risking lives. Aid helps fight poverty, prevent crises & boost security. Reverse ODA cuts & restore UK leadership in global development.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Stop bookmakers from banning or restricting customers Ban bookmakers from restricting or banning customers for winning or using strategy. We urge the government to introduce rules ensuring licensed bookmakers honour fair stakes for all, promoting fairness and transparency in the UK betting industry and protecting punters.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Re-establish Civil Defence Corps to enhance disaster response and emergencies. Re-establish a Civil Defence Corps or similar agency to address modern threats like climate disasters, pandemics, and nuclear incidents. This organisation should work with services, train the public, conduct community drills, and develop fallout shelter plans and radiological safety procedures.
label: Home Office

text: Exempt those involved in the killing of emergency workers from early release. Any person involved, in any way, directly or indirectly, in the killing of an emergency worker should be exempt from early release from prison and should complete the sentence as passed by a court of law.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Require shops to sell knives in lockable cabinet/behind a counter and ban offers At present there is "Sale of knives: voluntary agreement by retailers" 2016 (updated in 2024). Many do not follow this agreement so legislation needs to be brought in to force retailers to restrict access to knives to help stop them being stolen and also getting into the hands of children.
label: Home Office

text: Government must immediately move to increase defence spending as promised We believe the Government’s plan to increase national security expenditure to 5% and defence expenditure to 3.5% is a laudable aim. We do however believe there is far too little urgency about this planned increase.
label: Ministry of Defence

text: Government Funding for Nationwide Bluetongue Testing We urge the Government to provide funding to cover all testing costs imposed on farmers relating to Bluetongue. DEFRA should fund this, as costs could burden farmers unfairly. Testing requirements vary across the UK; the Government should fund these costs or scrap testing altogether.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Review Primary Curriculum to ensure alignment with Children’s Developmental Need We believe that the curriculum expects young children to master abstract maths and grammar too early, and that this could harm confidence and mental health. We think a review is needed to better align education with developmental science and help support real learning.
label: Department for Education

text: enquiry into OPG Power of Attorney laws/rules & police responses to POA abuse Commission an independent enquiry into the gap between OPG rules on the use and misuse of Power of Attorney and the inconsistent responses of police forces when POA‑related financial abuse is reported. Create clear national standards for investigating POA misuse.
label: Home Office

text: Set up an independent inquiry into West Indian children placed in ESN schools We want the Government to commission an independent inquiry into the unfair placement of West Indian children into Educationally Sub Normal (ESN) schools from the 1950s to the early 1970s. This inquiry should closely examine assessment practices, institutional biases, and local authority decisions.
label: Department for Education

text: Review traffic penalty laws to protect victims of driving licence identity fraud We call on the Government to conduct a review of traffic penalty laws and how take into account the risk of accused drivers being the victims of identity fraud.
label: Department for Transport

text: Statutory mental health early intervention framework for children & young people Introduce a statutory early intervention framework for children and young people to include: clear national thresholds for early intervention; mandatory multi-agency escalation pathways; and time-bound response requirements for assessment and support. These changes could be known as Mia's Law.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Mandatory pausing of civil court actions during domestic abuse investigations Introduce a requirement to pause or restrict civil family court actions, including occupation and financial orders, where there is an active domestic abuse criminal investigation or prosecution, unless there is a clear safeguarding necessity
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Require a full motorcycle license to use a motorcycle/scooter for hire/reward. Make those wishing to use a motorcycle/scooter for hire/reward require a full category AM/A1/A2/A license
label: Department for Transport

text: Increase New State Pension and pay to all, abolish the old Basic State Pension. We think the government should put all our elderly onto the New State Pension, increase the New State Pension to a good percentage of average earnings and abolish the old 'Basic State Pension'.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Review the sale of over the counter codeine A review could explore the feasibility of a system in which a notification is sent through to the patient's GP surgery. This way, there'd be a better audit trail for how many times someone purchases this medication. This could then be looked at if the patient is buying the medication regularly.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Introduce mandatory neutering of non-breeding cats Introduce legislation requiring neutering of non-breeding domestic cats, with exemptions for licensed breeders and cats with certified medical reasons.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Require registration, mot, road tax and insurance for all e-bikes Make all electric bikes subject to registration, mot, and road tax like requirements for other motorised vehicles. Also require riders of these bikes to be insured to do so.
label: Department for Transport

text: Review the tax system We think the tax system should be reviewed to reduce the percentage of tax on goods such as food, petrol/diesel, energy etc.
label: HM Treasury

text: Stop arms sales and any military support to Ukraine and Israel We demand the government cease all arms sales to these countries along with any military support. We believe we should end our part in the pain and destruction inflicted by war, and that we should not support weapons but invest the money in our own citizens and services.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Allow for all students in full-time education to receive free prescriptions. To introduce a bill to allow for all full-time students to receive free prescriptions, currently it stops at 18 years old but this excludes full-time university students who are older and mature students.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: No new capped safe and legal routes for refugees to come to the UK We want the Government to abandon its plans for "capped safe and legal" routes for refugees to come to the UK, including the new sponsorship scheme announced by the Home Secretary on 26 June
label: Home Office

text: Make it mandatory for foods that contain any alcohol to have logo All food containing alcohol should be clearly labelled. Cooking does not always remove residual amounts. For people in recovery, even trace exposure can trigger cravings and distress. Clear labelling protects informed choice, respects recovery, and supports cultural and personal boundaries.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Legislate for statutory regulation and protection of the title "Engineer" Legislate to protect and regulate the title of "Engineer". Make it so you can only call yourself an engineer with a degree level qualification from an accredited institution.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Ban the use of pesticides in children’s playgrounds and in schools in England We urge the Government to ban the use of pesticides in children’s playgrounds and schools in England, to protect children from what could be harmful chemicals.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Repeal the Human Rights Act 1998 We urge the Government to repeal the Human Rights Act 1998. We believe this would allow the UK to create a tougher deterrence to protect British borders and help stop illegal migration.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Ban betting on sports involving animals, including horses and dogs  We believe animals are not here for our entertainment and betting on them can lead to cases of abuse. They deserve better protection.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Don't introduce essentials-only benefit cards and protect claimants’ freedom Do not introduce benefits payment cards restricted to “essentials only” and keep benefits paid as normal money via bank accounts or cash access. Address fraud through targeted enforcement rather than blanket restrictions that affect all claimants.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Require autism-friendly interview adjustments and sensory-friendly jobs Require all Disability Confident employers to guarantee specific reasonable adjustments for neurodivergent candidates—such as remote interviews, autism-aware interviewers, advance questions, clear one-at-a-time queries, and rest breaks—and to create autism- and sensory-friendly roles and workplaces.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Stop considering asylum requests for 2 years to control illegal migration Suspend the asylum system for 2 years. We believe this could clear the asylum backlog and help the Government introduce a fairer asylum and welfare system, and suitable accommodation for genuine asylum seekers. We believe systems are abused, misused and broken.
label: Home Office

text: Do not refer to the state pensions as a benefit My Pension increase letter state's "ABOUT THE GENERAL INCREASES IN BENEFITS". I think my state pension is not a benefit, I have paid National Insurance Contributions and so did my employers.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Fund training & trauma assessments post discharge from mental health units We want the Government to limit the trauma following inpatient admissions to mental health units. We want to prevent people admitted as inpatients from dying from suicide. We want there to be a mandatory trauma assessment post-discharge from a long-term mental health admission.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Give private vehicle owners access to diagnostic tools and repair information Extend existing Right to Repair rules so private vehicle owners can legally access manufacturer diagnostic software, service procedures, and repair information on a paid, regulated basis, with appropriate safeguards, similar to access already available to independent repairers.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Government to commence the Medical Training (Prioritisation) Bill in 2027 The Government must ensure that the provisions of the Medical Training (Prioritisation) Bill once enacted come into force in 2027 not 2026, as the selection process is already underway for this year and a 2026 commencement would retrospectively affects this year’s process.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Allow Wales to hold an independence referendum We want the UK Parliament to allow and enable Wales to hold an independence referendum. We think the people of Wales must be given the chance to vote in a Wales independence referendum so they can choose to either stay a part of the UK or for Wales to be an independent country.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Increase funding for research and financial support for women with endometriosis We want the Government to provide greater financial support for women with endometriosis who are unable to work. Such as, increasing access to benefits like Personal Independence Payments (PIP) or Employment Support Allowance, and to increase funding for research.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Fund a medical cannabis reimbursement scheme for veterans ​ We want the UK Government to set up a reimbursement scheme for armed forces veterans who are prescribed medical cannabis by a specialist doctor.​
label: Ministry of Defence

text: Ban surface dressing as a method of road repair In our view, our roads are in an appalling state of repair but we do not believe that the practice of Surface Dressing is the solution. We think it’s a dangerous solution for all road users, especially motorcyclists and cyclists. I call on the government to ban this method of road repair.
label: Department for Transport

text: Donations to a political party capped at £500,000 per individual or organisation Donations to political parties, from an individual or organisation, should be limited to £500,000 across total donations. We think this could reduce the influence of unelected and foreign individuals on UK politics.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Enshrine the right for citizens to live offline in UK law Enshrine the right to live and participate in society without the internet or digitally connected services into UK law. We believe banking, voting, tax, public transport, food, education, etc., should never require ownership of a mobile phone or any digital devices.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Provide equal NHS funding for all Hospices Up and down the country, there is clear inequality within the NHS funding for palliative and end of life care. The aim of this petition is for a change to the funding so that all hospices receive the same amount.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Abolish business rates for UK pubs and hospitality businesses  Scrap business Rates for UK Hospitality sector full stop. This will encourage new and existing businesses to invest, whereas the current regime will see closures and job losses.
label: HM Treasury

text: Allow BNO visa holders to work in sports and grassroots coaching The BNO visa prohibits paid work as professional/semi-professional athletes or coaches in the UK, even at grassroots level. We ask the Government to remove this restriction.
label: Home Office

text: Reform Child Maintenance Service: Support Active Fathers & End Historic Arrears The CMS is meant to support children - we think that too often, it’s tearing families apart. We feel that many loving, active fathers are treated unfairly & that the CMS ignores shared parenting, fails to recognise time spent with children, & can create unaffordable debt that parents can’t dispute.
label: HM Treasury

text: Increase Funding for Mental Health Services in Schools for Students’ Well-being Increase funding for mental health services in schools. This could include programs promoting emotional well-being, coping skills and resilience. This may ensure schools are equipped to address mental health challenges some students may face, whether it’s anxiety, depression, or trauma.
label: Department for Education

text: Legally require unanimous jury verdicts for serious offences. We believe majority jury verdicts can lead to miscarriages of justice.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Review of the Royal Duchies, Crown estate and sovereign grant To carry out a full and comprehensive review of the Crown estate, royal duchies and the sovereign grant. This is in light of recent reports about the large rental income made from Duchies of Lancaster and Cornwall renting land to the NHS and the armed forces.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Deploy the Royal Navy to turn illegal small boats back to France We believe no boats containing illegal migrants should be allowed to land on our shores, including illegal migrants rescued at sea. We want the UK Government to deploy Royal Navy vessels to turn back all small boats that are attempting to illegally cross the Channel into the UK back to France.
label: Home Office

text: Increase the personal tax-free allowance to £26000 With the cost of living still high, we believe there’s strong cross-party and public pressure for tax relief.
label: HM Treasury

text: Allow state pension recipients to claim full carer’s allowance When you receive the state pension at 66, you are no longer able to claim the full Carer’s Allowance. I would like to see the government allow people who receive the state pension to claim the full carer’s allowance.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Legally require free access to period products in all public buildings Create a law like the free period product law in Scotland, which mandates that local authorities and education providers must make period products available free of charge. We would like the Government to fund free period products to be available in all public buildings.
label: Home Office

text: Give people power to dismiss MPs – change the Recall of MPs Act We think Parliament needs to change the Recall of MPs Act 2015 so that voters can start a recall petition at any time initiating a by-election, without needing certain circumstances to be met.
label: Office of the Leader of the House of Commons

text: Make teachers exempt from changes introduced in the Home Office whitepaper The UK suffers from a teacher shortage, especially in specialist fields like STEM. To help meet Labour's 6,500 new teacher pledge, we think the Government must acknowledge the social and economic contribution of migrant teachers and exempt them from changes like the increase in ILR residence period.
label: Home Office

text: Provide funding for a programme to clear the rubble & rebuild in Gaza We urge the Government to provide funding for a huge clearance of rubble and a rebuilding programme in Gaza.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Require Enhanced DBS Checks & Transparency for All Councillors and Politicians We call on the UK Government to introduce legislation requiring all elected councillors and politicians, at both local and national level, to undergo an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check before taking office and at regular intervals throughout their term.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Rename Teaching Assistants to Assistant Teachers to fully reflect their roles The government needs to change the perception of the contribution that Teaching Assistants actually provide to the education system, and better educate parents on the role they play.
label: Department for Education

text: Ban the sale of knives, crossbows and other weapons online I believe that if the sale of knives, crossbows and other weapons online was banned, it would be easier to control the purchase of these items. If they were only available to purchase in specialist shops and high street retailers, it could be ensured that ID is shown before purchase.
label: Home Office

text: Ban the purchase & delivery of alcohol via delivery apps Ban the purchase, sale and delivery of alcohol via delivery apps to protect vulnerable and people who are underage.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Ensure Home Office needs planning permission for all hotel asylum accommodation Amend the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 and the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 so the Home Office must always seek local planning permission before using any hotels to house asylum seekers, ensuring local councils and communities are consulted.
label: Home Office

text: Remove permitted development rights for telegraph poles & require full planning Remove permitted development rights for telegraph poles and require planning permission and resident consultation for all new installations.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Call for a review of endoscopy surveillance intervals for Barrett’s Oesophagus Barrett’s Oesophagus can progress to cancer silently, even without symptoms. We urge the Government to call for a review looking to shorten surveillance intervals to detect disease earlier, improve survival, and save lives.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban paid protesting We want paid protesting to be criminalised. We think it is insincere, immoral, and is little more than an act of paying people to create public nuisances, antagonise current protests and falsely sway public opinion.
label: Home Office

text: Remove all benefits for those guilty of supporting proscribed terrorist groups. Any individuals found guilty of belonging to or supporting a proscribed terror group should lose any entitlement to state benefits.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Abolish and replace the Local Government Pension Scheme We urge Parliament to abolish the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) and replace it with a more affordable alternative such as the NEST pension scheme. We believe this could reduce the financial burden on taxpayers and LAs, which could cut employer contributions and save taxpayer money.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Make teaching BSL mandatory in all schools There are about 50,000 deaf children in the UK. I would like the Government to make all schools introduce British sign language as a mandatory lesson in the curriculum.
label: Department for Education

text: Review CMS Payments To Ensure Fairness For Paying Parents and Children Government should review the Child Maintenance Service (CMS) to ensure it is fair and sustainable for both parents while supporting children appropriately.  It should protect paying parents from financial hardship and take blended families and additional dependent children into account fairly.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Stop the East West Rail (EWR) project. Save our homes and farmland. Immediately stop the EWR project and protect our countryside. Invest in repairing and improving existing rail infrastructure to help ensure more punctual, clean services with better facilities—before creating new lines that we think could devastate farmland, wildlife habitats, and rural communities.
label: Department for Transport

text: Deport asylum seekers from safe countries & review current asylum seekers We urge the Government to update migration laws so asylum seekers who arrive from a designated safe country are automatically refused and deported to the designated safe country they travelled from.
label: Home Office

text: Fund a free, nationwide 'Parental Control App' to keep all children safe online We believe there is a national mental health crisis with young people that is largely connected to increased time online, social media advances and algorithms. We believe this is having a devastating impact on young people’s physical and emotional development, and their safety.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Reduce University student tuition fee cap from £9,250 to £3,000 Call on the government to reduce the University Student Tuition Fees cap from £9,250 to £3,000 which the Government has now decided to increase to £9,535 from September 2025. This will put further financial stress on students who are already struggling with accommodation & other costs.
label: Department for Education

text: Require producers to declare how much metal is in food, drink and supplements We want the Government to make it a legal requirement for food, drink and supplement manufacturers to print clearly on all packaging exactly how much Calcium, Magnesium, Potassium, Sodium and other metals are present in a typical serving.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Legally require drivers who hit a cat to take them to a vet I would like to make it illegal to hit and leave a cat to die. When cats are sadly hit by cars, it can cause seriously bad mental health for the owners. Often they do not get to say goodbye. Cats are important to their owners. Make it illegal to leave them to die.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Amend laws on parental titles on birth certificates We believe UK law needs to be more flexible to allow parents to choose & amend the parental title recorded on their children’s birth certificates, to allow for two mothers/fathers. We think this is important to help formally recognise the realities of their lives and relationships.
label: Home Office

text: Review school absence fines & CAP peak pricing of activities in school holidays We want the government to cap excessive “peak pricing” on family attractions and travel during school holidays. We also want them to review term-time holiday fines and support businesses offering fair pricing with subsidies or tax relief.
label: Department for Education

text: Review how delivery companies operate and standards I would like a review into how delivery companies operate and some standards brought to bear, such as the ability to speak to a human and standards on what constitutes both a delivery and proof of delivery.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Only allow UK citizens or residents with settled status to use the NHS We urge the Government to only allow UK citizens or residents with settled status to use the NHS. We think everyone else should be required to have private insurance, including illegal migrants. We believe this could save the NHS money.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Review Pain Relief Standards For Invasive Women’s Health Procedures We urge the Government to review the guidelines for pain relief during women’s invasive health procedures. We would like this review to consider if adequate pain relief is being offered.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Stop ex-prime ministers being able to claim expenses from the taxpayer I am starting a petition to stop to ex-prime ministers from claiming the PDCA (public duty cost allowance). The PDCA allows a former prime minister to claim up to £115,000 a year- for life - for the 'necessary office costs and secretarial costs arising from their special position in public life'.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Introduce licences, number plates and insurance requirements for cyclists I would like the Government to introduce registration for cyclists so that they can be more easily punished when they do not obey the Highway Code.
label: Department for Transport

text: Allow emergency travel documents for British children born to overseas surrogacy Allow British children born overseas via surrogacy to return to the UK faster by issuing emergency travel documents, granting access to the fast track first passport service, or enabling a pre birth application process where nationality is evidenced before birth.
label: Home Office

text: Launch a review into student finance maintenance loan thresholds  We believe student finance maintenance loans are no longer reflective of household incomes. Two parents on the average UK salary means their child may be entitled to minimum. We believe this needs to be reconsidered immediately.
label: Department for Education

text: Allow all EU, EEA and Swiss nationals to enter UK with ID card We are looking for the Government to find a way to change entry rules so that all EU nationals can enter the UK for immigration purposes on their ID cards.
label: Home Office

text: Reverse increase of the UK partner visa income from £18,600 to £29,000 if in UK Lower the UK partner visa income threshold back to £18,600 for ALL genuine couples already living together in the UK. We think that the £29,000 requirement unfairly prevents many couples from staying together despite contributing to the UK economy and society.
label: Home Office

text: Fund specialised regional task forces to tackle bike & motorcycle theft We believe motorcycle owners across the country are targeted and endangered everyday by organised gangs of thieves. We call on the Government to fund dedicated regional task forces to manage a coordinated approach in tackling bike & motorcycle thieves and keeping all road users safe.
label: Department for Transport

text: Fund a new way to support young people with SEND in schools. Update national policy and provide funding so schools and local authorities can offer hybrid learning (blended mainstream + therapeutic/vocational/community outreach) as a first-line alternative to full-time mainstream or exclusion/PRU, with clear safeguards and accountability.
label: Department for Education

text: Funding and guidance for Equal Holiday Club Access for All SEN Children Every child deserves the chance to enjoy fun, safe, and inclusive holiday clubs but we feel too many children with Special Educational Needs are being left out. We call on government to ensure equal access to holiday provision for all children.
label: Department for Education

text: Introduce new guest safety and security standards for all hotels We want the Government to introduce mandatory national hotel safety and security standards, considering women and vulnerable guests, with secure room access, emergency contact, safeguarding, and clear risk-assessment.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Review NHS cancer treatment protocols We want a review of the NHS cancer treatment protocols, including awareness and use of drugs not commonly used for cancer treatment but repurposed (so called off label drugs), and supplements.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Require Government Ministers to hold sole British citizenship Cabinet ministers make decisions of the highest importance, including on defence, foreign policy, and national security. Holding citizenship of another nation may create perceived or actual conflicts of interest and can undermine public trust in government decision-making.
label: Cabinet Office

text: UK Government to open talks with EU on rejoining Custom Union and Single Market We think the government should seek to rejoin CU/SM as soon as possible to ensure seamless trade.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Reintroduce UK National ID cards for British citizens. We want the government to bring back national ID cards for British citizens. We think this would provide an easy and affordable way for everyone to prove their identity, ensuring inclusivity and accessibility for all.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Legalise Euthanasia for people with incurable mental and physical conditions. I would like the Government and Parliament to provide people who are suffering from incurable physical or mental conditions the right to choose voluntary Euthanasia if that is what they desire. I think that incurable suffering without an end can be inhumane.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Require bus operators to refund fares for service cancellations We demand that the government requires bus operators to refund passengers for cancellations. When bus operators fail to provide the paid-for service – such as by terminating routes early and stranding passengers – a refund system similar to train 'Delay Repay' or cancellation refunds should apply.
label: Department for Transport

text: Provide funding and relief to support struggling independent music venues We call on the Government to provide funding, such as dedicated grants, to support struggling independent venues. We also urge the Government to provide relief to these venues, by reforming business rates and treating them like other cultural institutions, such as theatres.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Increase waterway dredging to help prevent flooding Increase dredging of our waterways to assist in preventing flooding. We view dredging as essential to enhance the water-carrying capacity of our rivers & streams. By increasing this capacity, we could significantly help reduce the risk of flooding, which threatens businesses, homes, & lives.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Daisy Companion Law: Give emotional support animals equal status to service dogs Emotional support animals do not have the same legal status or protections as assistance dogs (like guide dogs) under the Equality Act 2010. This means that there is no legal obligation for employers to allow them into the workplace or access to public places.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Introduce a New Homicide Offence for Abuse Related Suicide We call on the UK Government to introduce a new, bespoke criminal offence recognising cases where controlling or coercive behaviour and other serious forms of domestic abuse contribute to a victim’s death by suicide.
label: Home Office

text: Relax EU meat and dairy personal import rules for travellers We ask for a review of the current blanket ban on personal imports of meat and dairy from the EU, to allow products that we think are low risk such as sealed, pasteurised or fully cooked items.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Allow electric e-scooters to be able to ride on pavements and roads I don't understand why Parliament have made this rule, I think e-scooters, bikes and other e modes of transport are a good thing.
label: Department for Transport

text: New housing developments to be primary residences to minimise environmental harm We call for a statutory requirement that all new housing quotas be allocated exclusively for primary residences, with restrictions preventing these homes from being sold or used as second homes for at least 25 years.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Hold an inquiry before transferring the Chagos Islands to Mauritius We call for the Government to hold an open and transparent inquiry on the UK’s proposal to transfer sovereignty over the Chagos Islands to Mauritius before carrying it out.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Introduce a higher, sector-specific Minimum Wage for PCAs and veterinary nurses Require veterinary employers to increase wages to £14 per hour for patient care assistants and £15.50 for vet nurses/vet techs. We feel the industry is extremely taxing on mental and physical health and has extremely high standards set in place.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Recognise Israeli Driving Licences as Exchangeable in the UK We ask the UK Government to review Israeli driving licence standards and, if comparable, add Israel to the list of designated countries whose licences can be exchanged for a UK licence without requiring a practical test, including exploring a reciprocal agreement.
label: Department for Transport

text: Remove the ‘right to roam’ status applicable to domesticated cats We feel it is now time to end the 'right to roam' for cats. Cats can have a serious impact on wildlife. A study published in 2022 estimated that cats kill 160 to 270 million animals every year, 25% of them are birds.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Changes of inspections for Early Years including how grading is given. We want the government to review how Ofsted conducts inspections, as well as how the results of inspections can unfairly impact early years education providers. We think that providers should have the opportunity to act on recommendations before any final grade is given.
label: Department for Education

text: Fund "Universal" Breakfast Clubs to include all SEND Children While the Equality Act 2010 requires 'reasonable adjustments’ in our view the current funding model for breakfast clubs makes 1-1 support for children who need it financially impossible for schools. We are calling for the government to provide SEND funding for this.
label: Department for Education

text: Keep the 5-year pathway for all legal immigrants to apply for ILR The Government should stop its plans to change the 5-year pathway for legal immigrants to apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain, potentially including immigrants who are already living and working in the UK and have already been on the pathway since 2021.
label: Home Office

text: Require All Food Delivery Motorcycle Riders to Hold a Full Motorcycle Licence We, the undersigned, call upon the Government to introduce legislation requiring all motorcycle and moped delivery riders to hold a full, valid motorcycle licence before being permitted to work in the food delivery industry.
label: Department for Transport

text: Review evidence and fund addition of Fabry disease to the newborn screening test Provide funding to add Fabry disease to the newborn screening programme via the existing heel-prick test. Early detection could allow faster treatment and help identify affected families. Review the evidence and begin a process of funding the addition of the disease to the test.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Fund free hospital parking in England for all patients We would like the government to bring England inline with Scotland and Wales and fund free hospital parking for all patients at NHS hospitals. It's an extra cost paid by patients or those visiting loved ones, and we think it is unfair for patients in England to be treated differently in this way.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Fund Improved Access to NHS Orthodontics for Children with Airway Problems We want the Government to fund improved access to NHS orthodontic assessments for children with airway or breathing problems, including sleep apnoea, who also have narrow jaws or a narrow palate. Where early treatment is clinically needed, it should be available through the NHS.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Keep B1 English for Skilled Worker visa holders; B2 only for new applicants We want the Government to keep the current B1 English requirement for Skilled Worker visa holders already in the UK and ensure the new B2 requirement applies only to future applicants.
label: Home Office

text: Review COVID and RSV vaccine eligibility for preterm children We call on the Government to review eligibility for COVID-19 and RSV immunisation to include children born extremely premature (under 28 weeks), particularly those diagnosed with chronic lung disease of prematurity.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Mandate neutering of free roaming pet Cats Many cats live outdoors unneutered, making it difficult to trace ownership or determine whether a cat has been lost or abandoned. This lack of identification can leave cats vulnerable to neglect, suffering, and uncontrolled breeding.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund and require routine cervical screening every 2 yrs Reduce the wait time between cervical screening, including for possible cancer, by requiring routine testing every 2 years, fully funded. They are currently every 5 years after being at 3 years for a while, which I believe could be extremely dangerous to women's health.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Appoint a Cabinet Minister for Disability & Equalities Appoint a Minister for Disability & Equalities, with responsibility for overseeing disability rights, equality policy, fair treatment of all disabled people as disability affects all the protected characteristics.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Require & fund healthcare services prior to building housing developments We believe combined cumulative impacts of housing developments on healthcare services are not being adequately assessed despite requirements under the NPPF. We believe infrastructure improvements must precede new housing developments, and developers should be mandated to pay.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Review endometriosis treatment options and communication of these to patients In my experience, endometriosis and the treatment available for it is not properly explained to patients. I want the government to fund a review of the two most common treatments, ablation and excision, and for options to be properly explained to patients prior to their surgery.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Give patients a right to receive a medical second opinion We call on the Government to introduce legislation giving patients a clear legal right to receive a second medical opinion within the NHS, without fear of refusal, delay, or negative impact on their ongoing care.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Change the burden of proof in the Family Courts I want the government to change the law so that the burden of proof in the Family Courts changes from a 'balance of probabilities' to 'beyond reasonable doubt'. Especially when cases may involve the loss of contact between a child and their parent.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Ban UK companies shipping and insuring all Russian Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Russia is helping finance its illegal invasion of Ukraine by oil and gas exports, including LNG. The UK sanctions all imports of Russian oil and gas. It also sanctions the shipping and insurance of Russian oil sold above a cap. It must now sanction the shipping and insurance of all Russian LNG.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Make all grass verge parking illegal We want the government to make grass verge parking illegal.
label: Department for Transport

text: End the UK’s membership of the World Health Organisation The World Health Organisation is not a democratically elected body and we are concerned about the powers WHO may be given over Sovereign Nations in the future.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text:
Make private flyers pay for their Carbon emissions UK Government must legislate to:
*Tax jet fuel
*Increase other taxes & duties on planes with few passengers
*Require fuel for outbound flights to be bought in the UK to avoid tax evasion and curb carbon emissions
*Require private jets to carbon offset
label: Department for Transport

text: Ban the import of Antarctic Krill Products into the UK Ban the import of products containing Antarctic krill, including supplements, fish food, fish fed with feed containing Antarctic krill, and farmed salmon feed, to stop their use in the UK and to help protect Antarctic wildlife, ecosystems, and the global climate.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Launch a public inquiry into the failures of HS2 Launch a public inquiry with statutory responsibility to hold to account anyone responsible for the costs on UK taxpayers due to HS2. The inquiry should look at ways to hold accountable those responsible for what we believe has been one of the greatest failures in public spending.
label: Department for Transport

text: Ban abortions after 24 weeks due to Down's syndrome diagnosis Amend laws relating to abortion to equalise the 24 week limit for abortions in cases where the baby has been diagnosed with Down’s syndrome. We believe that the law should affirm the equal value and dignity of all lives, ensuring that every child has a fair chance to make their mark in the world.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Introduce mandatory driving retests for drivers over the age of 70 We want the Government to introduce mandatory driving retests for drivers over the age of 70. We think this will make the road safer for everyone: motorcyclists, pedestrians and car users.
label: Department for Transport

text:
Stronger legislation to ban and stop all puppy farming

 We urge the government to introduce legislation to stop and ban all forms of puppy farming, ending the mass breeding of dogs in cruel, profit-driven conditions.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund barriers and cameras to make bridges and motorways safer Sadly, there are around 50 suicides per year on roads in the UK. We feel that there should be more funding put towards making bridges and motorways safer, to prevent people losing a family member/friend.
label: Department for Transport

text: Cancel the British Council’s Covid Debt Now The British Council, seen as a cornerstone of UK global influence, is reported to be under threat from an unsustainable Covid-era debt which is driving cuts, instability, and loss of assets. We call on the UK Government to cancel this debt and protect its future.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban councils from removing the Union Flag and the flags of the four nations  Ban councils from removing UK national flags displayed in public
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Fund a national memorial for those in unmarked / unnamed mental asylum graves Thousands of people died in Victorian-era mental health hospitals and many of their bodies were not claimed by next of kin. Many were buried in unnamed pauper burial plots. Many burial sites are unmarked, neglected, or may even be sold, which we believe dooms patients to an eternity of anonymity.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Ban companies from charging more for hygiene products targeted to females We think it's unfair that there is often a price difference between male and female hygiene products. Females often have to pay more for hygiene products and we want prices to be equalised.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Legal restrictions on heading in football training to protect players’ brains Create clear, legal restrictions to limit repetitive heading in football training to protect children, young people & all players from repeated head impacts. Some data suggests more than 5m children & 10m adults in England play football. We're concerned that they're in danger.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Grant automatic citizenship to ARAP Afghans lawfully residing in UK for 5 years Create a clear, expedited route to citizenship for Afghans resettled under ARAP, many with ILR since 2021. Grant automatic citizenship with no need to apply if they have 5 years' continuous residence, pass the Life in the UK test, have English competency, good character and no criminal convictions.
label: Home Office

text: National scheme for QR code driver identification for all Hackney Carriage cabs Introduce a mandatory national QR code identification system displayed in the rear passenger area of all Hackney Carriages. When scanned, this QR code could include the driver’s full name, photograph, badge/licence number, the vehicle registration and current licensing status.
label: Department for Transport

text: Improve food labelling laws to clearly list all ingredients Update food labelling laws so all ingredients, including starches and flavourings, must be clearly listed on packaging and menus. This should apply to pre-packed food, restaurants, takeaways and online food ordering to ensure safety for people with allergies and dietary needs.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Introduce employment rights for sex workers I would like sex workers to be entitled to official employment contracts, pensions, maternity leave, and sick days. Essentially, in my view, for it to be treated like any other job.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Politicians who lie should be barred from standing for election Politicians who are proven to knowingly lie and mislead the electorate should not be allowed to stand for election again.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Ban fear and psychological tactics in Government advice and messaging Make it illegal for all government bodies and representatives to use fear, coercion, or covert psychological tactics like nudging, emotional priming, or perception manipulation in any public advice or communication.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Raise the expensive car supplement threshold to £50k Raise the expensive car supplement, also known as the "luxury car tax" threshold from £40,000 to £50,000 to better reflect current car prices and help ensure fairness for ordinary buyers.
label: Department for Transport

text: Legalise small scale Cannabis cultivation for medical patients Allow the cultivation of no more than three (3) Cannabis SP. plants for personal use if the patient has a Medical Cannabis prescription.
label: Home Office

text: Review misleading practices relating to government domestic solar/biomass scheme Launch a review of misleading business practices of domestic solar and biomass schemes sold under government initiatives such as the feed-in tariff.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text:
Regulate Ultra Processed Food (UPF) packaging and marketing We believe public awareness about UPFs is akin to that of tobacco in the 1960s.
We think consumers may find it difficult to make informed choices about the reported health risks associated with UPFs.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Require police to delete data collected due to false allegations. We believe the Government should establish a legal requirement for the deletion of data, including biometric data, relating to an individual, where the case against them is withdrawn at any stage and there is corroborative evidence that the case was based on a malicious or false allegation.
label: Home Office

text:
Restrict entry to 1 puppy and require review of pedigree and sale at the border Amendment the Animal Welfare (Import of Dogs, Cats and Ferrets) Act to:
- Allow a puppy to be imported at 12 weeks following rabies vaccination.
- Allow only 1 puppy under 6 (or 12) months old per vehicle or foot passenger
- Require a copy of official pedigree and contract of sale at the border
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Make Ketamine a Class A drug and fund better support, awareness and research I urge the UK Government to reclassify ketamine from a Class B to a Class A controlled drug under the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 due to the increasing harm it is causing to individuals, families and communities.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Ban water company bill hikes & reduce shareholder dividends to fund repairs  We ask the Government to require Ofwat to ban water companies from increasing charges for customers for historic underinvestment where profits were paid to shareholders. Repairs to be paid by reducing shareholder dividends before bill increases.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text:
Stop the government banking with banks who invest in fossil fuel companies We want the Government Banking Service that supports the NHS to stop working with banks that provide finance to fossil fuel companies.
We want to prevent ill health caused by fossil fuel combustion.
We want an NHS focused on preventative healthcare from bank account to bedside.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Seek a UK-EU deal to scrap the Entry/Exit System for travel under 90 days We ask the Government to work with the EU to seek a deal to prevent UK citizens needing ETIAS when visiting the EU for 90 days or less, and to drop the requirements for EU citizens needing an ETA as well for less than 90 days.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Reintroduce the dog licence for dog owners We think that the introduction of a dog licence for owners will reduce irresponsible dog ownership, unscrupulous breeding and create accountability. We think that rescues and the veterinary industry are at breaking point because of dog ownership proliferation.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Fund cannabis prescriptions for fibromyalgia and other pain conditions I would like the government to fund the NHS to prescribe medical cannabis for people with fibromyalgia and other severe pain patients. Some people find that the prescription meds currently prescribed do not work.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Allow those on 5-year ILR route to combine time spent on all eligible visas Currently, some visa holders must restart their 5-year qualifying period for indefinite leave to remain (ILR) when switching between eligible visa categories. We believe this is creating unnecessary barriers to settlement and potentially increasing the risk of exploitation.
label: Home Office

text: Review maternity guidance for women pregnant after a previous stillbirth Review maternity guidance for women with a previous stillbirth who attend hospital with reduced fetal movements, to ensure their previous loss is recognised and they receive appropriate assessment, personalised care and support in subsequent pregnancies.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Create a legal right for families to request copies of CCTV of homicide victims  We want to create a statutory right for families of homicide victims to obtain physical/digital copies of CCTV footage featuring their deceased loved one. This should be known as James’s Law,  so Police aren’t stopped from providing copies to families by citing third-party ownership/data protection.
label: Home Office

text:
Cap student loan interest rates at inflation (CPI), do not apply retrospectively We ask the Government to:
Cap student loan interest at inflation (CPI), and
Ensure future changes are not applied retrospectively to existing borrowers.
We think this would restore fairness, transparency, and confidence in the student finance system.
label: Department for Education

text: End the UK's asylum system & right to asylum, use resources for border security We want the Government to legislate to end the UK asylum system. Remove the right to claim asylum in the UK, withdrawing from treaties that compel us to take asylum seekers, and closing all asylum centres. Resources should go to border security and swift deportation of those who arrive illegally.
label: Home Office

text: Increase Luxury Car supplement threshold to £53k, in line with inflation Adjust Luxury Car VED threshold in line with inflation. We think this should be done at each budget. We think leaving this frozen at £40k has been another increased and unfair cost to the General Public. We believe it should be applied to all used cars under 5yrs old in a fair backdated scheme.
label: HM Treasury

text: Require disabled toilets on all commercial flights We believe that having a disabled toilets on commercial flights would massively benefit many people.
label: Department for Transport

text: Do not increase University Tuition Fees in 2026 We call on the Government to reconsider the increase of the University tuition fee cap in 2026, and keep it at the current level rather than increasing it to meet inflation.
label: Department for Education

text: Government to change the guidelines on double mastectomies We call on the Government to change the guidelines regarding mastectomies to make it mandatory for all patients who are recommended a single mastectomy to be offered a double mastectomy. I had a single mastectomy and the other side won't be removed. Why can't I sleep or feel comfortable.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Increase funding for NHS dentists and the NHS dentistry system Provide funding to help build a stronger NHS Dentistry System for all to benefit from. Increase the funding for dentists and appointments so a greater amount of patients can see a dentist.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Make controlled burning mandatory for landowners We want the UK Government to make prescribed burning mandatory for Landowners in order to mitigate the impact of Wildfires on Moorland, Heathland and in Woodland.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Require employers to give annual leave equal to at least 20-25% of hours worked We are calling for an increase in minimum level of annual leave, to be calculated as 20-25% of total hours worked, not a fixed allocation of days. This could also help people to take mental health days and encourage healthier workloads. Burnout, stress, and poor recovery are rising
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text:
Cyclists to be licenced, registered to be on the road and have insurance 1 All adults cyclists to have some kind of registration for their bikes like other road users
2 All adult cyclists to have valid insurance while on the road just like other road users
3 Cycling test to raise safety awareness and while on the road
4 Fines to be issued for not complying with this
label: Department for Transport

text: Reverse ISA allowance cuts & salary-sacrifice pension contribution caps We want the Government to reverse plans to cut ISA allowances AND place new caps on salary-sacrifice pension contributions. We believe ISA limits and salary-sacrifice rules should stay unchanged to protect access to tax-efficient saving, and Parliament should oppose attempts to reduce these benefits
label: HM Treasury

text: Introduce standing orders giving equal time at PMQs to opposition party leaders We petition the House of Commons to introduce standing orders governing Prime Minister's Questions (PMQs) to ensure that the number of questions allocated to party leaders are shared equally among the leaders of all recognised opposition parties in the House of Commons, including smaller parties.
label: Office of the Leader of the House of Commons

text: Introduce UK-led humanitarian aid sea corridor for navy-escorted aid to Gaza We call on the UK Government to lead a Navy-escorted humanitarian sea corridor to deliver food and aid directly to Gaza, where famine is confirmed by the IPC. Britain should act with an international coalition, as we believe history will remember inaction that caused preventable deaths.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Ban plea bargains in domestic violence cases if perpetrator has prior conviction I want the government to put stricter regulations in place that prevent perpetrators being able to enter a plea bargain.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Make large venues offer hygienic spaces for disabled medical needs Change the law to require large venues to provide dedicated, hygienic spaces for disabled people to manage medical needs beyond just standard toilet facilities. This would include safe areas for tube feeding or medication use. We believe this will ensure dignity, safety, and accessibility for all.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Raise the standard tax-free Personal Allowance to £45,000. The Personal Allowance is the amount of income a person can get before they pay tax. It stands at £12,570 in 2025. We would like the standard Personal Allowance raised to what we think is a more realistic figure of £45,000.
label: HM Treasury

text: Give kinship carers equal financial & legal support to foster carers  We want the Government to ensure kinship carers are not pushed into poverty for keeping children out of care by ensuring kinship carers are entitled to equal financial and legal support enjoyed by foster carers, including benefits, housing protections and legal aid.
label: Department for Education

text: Fund the installation of metal detectors in all schools In recent years, concern for children’s safety in schools has grown significantly amongst many people in the UK, and this issue deeply resonates with me as a parent, due to the rise in incidents involving weapons on school premises. Shockingly, many students have begun to carry knives.
label: Department for Education

text: Make a criminal offence not to label AI generated media & communication as such We would like parliament to introduce a law to make it a criminal offence for people or organisations not to clearly indicate where media or a form of communication has been partially or wholly generated by Artificial Intelligence.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Mandate that all dentists provide minimum amount of NHS services Millions lack NHS dental care. We demand a 50% NHS allocation mandate for all dentist practices, requirements to ensure all NHS treatment that is needed for a particular patient is carried out, and a rule requiring practices to accept new NHS patients in their area.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Give public option to opt out of taxes supporting British military operations We want the Government to provide the option for the public to opt out of their tax money from being used to support any overseas operations conducted by the British military. This should be through the HMRC account.
label: HM Treasury

text: Make public EV charging subject to the same VAT rate as home charging We want the Government to reduce VAT on public electric vehicle (EV) charging from 20% to the same rate applied to home charging. EV drivers who cannot charge at home should not be penalised through higher costs simply because of their housing circumstances.
label: HM Treasury

text: Ban all raw sewage dumping, mandate real time warning system & investment Introduce a total ban on raw sewage dumping to remove what we consider as the storm overflows “loophole”. There should also be a real-time warning system for every spill: location, volume, risk. Water companies should be mandated to put more of their profits into new pipes and storage tanks.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Ban the use of AI generated models in advertising campaigns We think a new law should be introduced to ban the use of AI generated models in advertising campaigns of any form; such as in magazines, store front windows, billboards etc.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Put 500% tariffs on goods from Israel until humanitarian aid restored to Gaza Place tariffs of 500% on all goods entering the UK from Israel until vital humanitarian supplies and services are fully and consistently restored to Gaza to levels deemed necessary by the UN. The humanitarian aid should include water, fuel and electricity as well as food and medical supplies.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Replace life sentences with whole life terms for the most serious offenders We call upon the UK Government to implement legislation that replaces life sentences with whole life terms for offenders whose crimes demonstrate the highest level of severity, such as premeditated murder or violent sexual offences, ensuring no eligibility for parole.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Drivers arrested for drug driving to be banned immediately Change the law surrounding dangerous driving to mandate that people who are arrested for having illegal drugs in their system while driving are immediately banned, there and then. We believe this will help prevent further accidents or death.
label: Department for Transport

text: Make aggressive social media auditing a criminal offence Social media auditing is the past-time of a person, usually referred to as an "auditor", visiting a location with the intention of exercising their rights to film and take photographs at that location. They later upload their footage of the location to social media.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Change the legal definition of Rape to allow women to be charged with rape Amend the current legal definition of rape to allow for women to be charged with it, rather than just men as is the current situation laid out by the Sexual Offences Act.
label: Home Office

text: A commission to investigate the feasibility & introduction of a Land Value Tax In light of the recent Inheritance Tax changes, we call on the government to establish a commission to investigate the feasibility & implementation of a Land Value Tax (LVT) as a replacement for property taxes. We believe this could reduce the tax burden on people's work on their property.
label: HM Treasury

text: Require security risk assessments and fund security measures for schools Make it mandatory to carry out security risk assessments in schools, and fund targeted security measures for schools. This could include handheld metal detectors, supervised bag checks and other screening measures to stop weapons entering school premises.
label: Department for Education

text: Review existing safeguards for UK national crew working on cruise ships Review safeguarding and reporting requirements which should protect UK crew members working on cruise ships, ensuring serious incidents reported by crew are independently recorded, investigated, and referred to appropriate authorities.
label: Department for Work and Pensions

text: Review law around treatment of animals in labs We urge the government to review law around treatment for animals in labs. Animals deserve better lives before death. End cruel practices, allow testing only when life-saving, and rehome animals instead of killing them after use.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text: Intervene through military means to get food and baby formula into Gaza We want the UK government to intervene through military means if needed to feed Palestinians who are facing starvation. We especially want baby milk and special formula for neonates to be flooded into Gaza.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Give maternity leave to those who've suffered baby loss from 20 weeks gestation I wish for the government to grant maternity leave after baby loss form 20 weeks gestation. I think this should be an option for those who still need time to heal, as 2 weeks bereavement after losing your child is not only too little for a physical recovery but for mental recovery too.
label: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

text: Increase funding for border security and patrols in UK waters. We urge the Government to allocate additional funding for border security, enhancing maritime patrols to effectively monitor and protect UK waters. This investment could be used to enhance the border patrol fleet to ensure a robust response to illegal crossings.
label: Home Office

text: Do not lower the voting age to 16 We think the Government's plans to lower the voting age to 16 years old wouldn't work. We say we should keep it at 18+.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Remove VAT from pet food and prescription medications for pets Currently, pet food & prescription meds attract a rate of 20% VAT, in direct contrast to their human equivalents where VAT is usually not charged. Pets are much loved family members, so why should pet owners be discriminated against? Removing VAT could help struggling pet owners.
label: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

text:
New programme of support & housing for homeless veterans 
 I want the Government to develop a dedicated programme for homeless veterans. This should include priority access to social and supported housing, temporary shelters, and wraparound services like mental health support, employment help, and financial advice.
label: Ministry of Defence
