text: Increase regulation of political advertising The Advertising Standards Authority oversees all product advertising in the UK to prevent false or misleading information being included. We think this same level of scrutiny should be applied to political advertising. We think there needs to be independent regulation in this area.
label: Cabinet Office

text: Create a national badge for parent and child spaces. I would like a badge introduced for parent and child spaces so others don't park there. We think the government should create a yellow badge for parents of children up to the age of 12 which enables them to park in parent and child spaces.
label: Department for Transport

text: Ban industrial developments being built next to any residential housing estates We call on the Government to amend planning policy to prevent B8 warehouses and any industrial developments being built next to residential housing estates. Mandatory buffer zones should be established to protect residents from noise, traffic, pollution, flooding & loss of residential amenities.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Require & Fund Air Conditioning in all early years settings Require all nurseries and early years settings to maintain temperatures below a safe specified temperature for children with funding for effective cooling systems where needed. As heatwaves become more common, no baby or young child or staff caring for them should be exposed to unsafe indoor heat.
label: Department for Education

text: Set minimum safety measures for health & social care workers in the community Surveys reveal that nearly half of social workers face verbal abuse, & up to 25% are threatened with physical violence during their careers. I want the Government to consider mandating minimum protective measures for social workers similar to those for the police and other emergency workers.
label: Department of Health and Social Care

text: Review the social impact of the reduction of voluntary sector funding Instruct an independent review into the extent of dwindling funds made available to voluntary sector organisations, and the social impact of this in the next 2-5 years.
label: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government

text: Make it illegal to photograph minors in public without parental consent. Make it illegal to photograph minors in public spaces without the consent of a parent or legal guardian where the child is the main subject of the image, and prohibit the online sharing of such images without consent.
label: Home Office

text: Ban letters and visits related to TV licence checks if a licence is not needed Address the stress and anxiety that can be caused by TV licence enforcement letters and visits when it's already been declared that one is not needed.
label: Department for Culture, Media and Sport

text: Protect FCDO expertise on humanitarian, development and peace capacity from cuts Pause FCDO plans to cut around 2,000 staff in the name of “agility” weakening UK diplomacy and response to crisis. Preserve expertise developed over the past years humanitarian, development, conflict and gender; and carry out humanitarian, climate and equality impact assessment before changes.
label: Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office

text: Change the legal age of consent to intercourse to 18 To change the legal age of sexual consent to 18 instead of 16
label: Home Office

text: Review punishment of Child Sex Offences Review sentencing to ensure penalties reflect the severity and long-term harm of child sexual abuse. Offenders convicted of child sexual offences must serve their full terms in Category B prisons or higher. There should also be mandatory lifetime registration and electronic monitoring.
label: Ministry of Justice

text: Fund more training for teachers to support children with SEN There should be more funding for more training and awareness around children with special educational needs. We believe there is a lack of understanding around special needs, and therefore a lack of understanding on how to support these children.
label: Department for Education

text: Raise ILR eligibility threshold to 15 years for future & current visa holders Amend immigration rules to increase the minimum residency period for ILR to 15 years. This change should apply to all visa holders, including those currently residing in the UK, to ensure consistent and long-term integration.
label: Home Office
